я.analysis: Personal pronoun, 1st sg. nominative ('I'). Russian often drops the subject pronoun because the verb ending already marks person.

встретимся.analysis: 1pl future of встретиться (perf., reflexive, 'to meet up'). The -ся suffix marks the reciprocal sense.

еду.analysis: 1sg present of ехать (impf., 'to go by vehicle'). Pair with на + prep. for mode of transport (на машине, на велосипеде).

плачу.analysis: 1sg present of платить (impf., 'to pay'). Governs за + acc. for the item paid for.

картой.analysis: Instrumental sg. of карта (f. noun, 'card'). Instrumental marks the means of payment ('by card').

иду.analysis: 1sg present of идти (impf., unidirectional motion on foot).

в.analysis: Preposition. With acc. = direction into ('to'); with prep. = location inside ('in').

магазин.analysis: M. noun, 'shop/store'. Shares a root with English 'magazine' (originally a storehouse).

на.analysis: Preposition. With prep. = location 'on/at'; with acc. = direction 'onto'. Also used for modes of transport (на велосипеде).

велосипеде.analysis: Prepositional sg. of велосипед (m. noun, 'bicycle'). Used after на to mean 'by/on bicycle'.

мне.analysis: Dative sg. of я ('to/for me'). Used in dative constructions like мне нужно ('I need') or мне нравится ('I like').

нужна.analysis: Short-form adjective (f. sg.) of нужный ('needed'). Agrees with the noun being needed: m. нужен, n. нужно, pl. нужны.

вода.analysis: F. noun, 'water'. Stress falls on the ending in nom./gen. sg. (va-DA) but shifts to the stem in acc. sg. (vó-du).

где.analysis: Interrogative adverb of location ('where'). For direction ('where to'), use куда.

находится.analysis: 3sg present of находиться (impf., reflexive, 'to be located'). Standard verb for describing where things are.

ближайшая.analysis: Superlative adjective (f. sg.) of близкий ('near'). The suffix -айш-/-ейш- forms the superlative: 'nearest/closest'.

плохо.analysis: Adverb, 'badly/poorly'. Also serves as the neuter short-form adjective and as an impersonal predicate (мне плохо, 'I feel bad').

по-русски.analysis: Adverb, 'in Russian'. The pattern по- + adj. stem + -и/-ски forms manner adverbs for languages (по-английски, по-французски).

повторите.analysis: Imperative (formal/pl.) of повторить (perf., 'to repeat'). Use повтори for informal sg.

пожалуйста.analysis: Particle, 'please' or 'you're welcome'. Commonly reduced in speech to 'pa-ZHAL-sta'.

сколько.analysis: Interrogative quantifier ('how much/many'). Governs gen. on the counted noun (сколько воды, сколько лет).

стоит.analysis: 3sg present of стоить (impf., 'to cost'). Distinguish by stress from сто́ит ('stands', from стоять).

этот.analysis: Demonstrative pronoun, m. sg. ('this'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with its noun: f. эта, n. это, pl. эти.

рыба.analysis: F. noun, 'fish' (RÝ-ba). Used both for the live animal and the food.

билет.analysis: M. noun, 'ticket'. For destination, pair with в/на + acc. (билет в Москву).

москву.analysis: Accusative sg. of Москва (proper f. noun, 'Moscow'). After в, acc. marks direction of motion ('to Moscow').

нужно.analysis: Impersonal predicate, 'it is necessary'. Used with dat. + infinitive (мне нужно идти, 'I need to go').

вызвать.analysis: Perf. infinitive, 'to summon/call out' (impf. вызывать). Used for calling a doctor, taxi, or causing a reaction.

врача.analysis: Accusative/genitive sg. of врач (m. animate noun, 'doctor'). Animate masculines take -а in acc. sg.

как.analysis: Adverb/conjunction, 'how/as'. Asks manner ('how?') or makes comparisons; common in set phrases like как можно скорее.

скорее.analysis: Comparative of скоро/скорый ('soon/quick'), meaning 'sooner/faster'. Also a hedging particle ('rather, more likely').

у.analysis: Preposition + gen. Marks possession (у меня есть, 'I have') or proximity ('near, at someone's place').

меня.analysis: Genitive/accusative sg. of я. Used after prepositions taking gen. (у меня) and as the direct object of transitive verbs.

нет.analysis: Negation word, 'no' or 'there is no'. As an existential negative, it triggers gen. on the missing item (нет паспорта).

паспорта.analysis: Genitive sg. of паспорт (m. noun, 'passport'). Required after the negative existential нет.

и.analysis: Coordinating conjunction ('and'). Joins items of equal grammatical weight: nouns, verbs, or full clauses.

телефона.analysis: Genitive sg. of телефон (m. noun, 'phone'). Required after the negative existential нет.

хочу.analysis: 1sg present of хотеть (impf., 'to want'). Irregular: stem alternates х/ч across the conjugation (хочу, хочешь, хочет, хотим).

заказать.natural: To order; to place an order.
заказать.analysis: Perf. infinitive, 'to order/reserve' (impf. заказывать). Takes a direct object in acc.

чашку.analysis: Accusative sg. of чашка (f. noun, 'cup'). As a container measure, it takes the contents in gen. (чашку кофе).

горячего.analysis: Gen. m./n. sg. of горячий (adj., 'hot'). The -го ending is pronounced 'va' (ga-RYA-che-va).

кофе.analysis: M. noun, 'coffee'. Indeclinable: the form stays the same across all cases.

вас.analysis: Genitive/accusative of вы. Used as direct object or after prepositions taking gen. (для вас, 'for you').

вы.analysis: Personal pronoun, 2nd pl. nominative. Also the formal/polite singular 'you'; default for strangers and superiors.

понимаете.analysis: 2pl present of понимать (impf., 'to understand'). Same form serves the polite singular вы.

что.analysis: Interrogative/relative pronoun ('what') and subordinating conjunction ('that'). Pronounced 'SHTO'.

сейчас.analysis: Adverb, 'now/right now'. Literally 'this hour'; often pronounced 'shchas' in fast speech.

сказал.analysis: Past tense m. sg. of сказать (perf., 'to say'). F. сказала, n. сказало, pl. сказали.

не.analysis: Negation particle. Placed directly before the word it negates (usually a verb).

быть.analysis: Impf. infinitive, 'to be/exist'. Usually omitted in present tense; future uses буду/будешь/etc.

он.analysis: Personal pronoun, 3rd m. sg. nominative ('he/it' for m. nouns). Oblique forms begin with н- after prepositions (него, нём).

а.analysis: Coordinating conjunction marking mild contrast or topic shift ('and/but/whereas'). Softer than но.

по.analysis: Preposition. With dat. = 'along, around, according to'; with acc. = 'up to'; with prep. = 'after'.

это.analysis: Demonstrative pronoun, n. sg. of этот. Also used invariably as 'this is/it is' to introduce or identify (это книга).

она.analysis: Personal pronoun, 3rd f. sg. nominative ('she/it' for f. nouns). Oblique forms begin with н- after prepositions (неё, ней).

они.analysis: Personal pronoun, 3rd pl. nominative ('they'). Oblique forms begin with н- after prepositions (них, ними).

мы.analysis: Personal pronoun, 1st pl. nominative ('we'). Oblique stem: нас/нам/нами.

из.analysis: Preposition + gen., 'from/out of'. Pairs with в (motion in) as its directional opposite.

который.analysis: Relative pronoun ('which/who/that'). Agrees in gender and number with its antecedent; case is determined by its role in the clause.

то.analysis: Demonstrative pronoun, n. sg. of тот ('that'). Also the correlative 'then' in если...то constructions.

за.analysis: Preposition. With acc. = direction 'behind/for' (плачу за кофе); with instr. = location 'behind' or 'after' (за столом).

свой.analysis: Reflexive possessive pronoun, 'one's own'. Refers back to the subject of the clause; agrees in gender, number, and case with the possessed noun.

весь.analysis: Determiner/pronoun, m. sg. ('all/whole'). Agrees with its noun: f. вся, n. всё, pl. все.

год.analysis: M. noun, 'year'. Irregular gen. pl. лет is used after numerals 5+ and quantifiers (много лет, пять лет).

от.analysis: Preposition + gen., 'from/away from'. Marks the source or starting point of movement; pairs with к (toward).

так.analysis: Adverb/particle, 'so/thus/that way'. Also the correlative to как in так..., как ('as... as').

для.analysis: Preposition + gen., 'for/for the sake of'. Marks the intended recipient or purpose.

ты.analysis: Personal pronoun, 2nd sg. nominative; informal 'you'. Use with family, friends, children; switch to вы for strangers and superiors.

все.analysis: Nom./acc. pl. of весь, used as a pronoun meaning 'everyone/all (people)'. Contrast with всё (n. sg., 'everything').

тот.analysis: Demonstrative pronoun, m. sg. ('that'). Points to something more distant or previously mentioned; f. та, n. то, pl. те.

мочь.analysis: Impf. infinitive, 'to be able to/can'. Irregular conjugation: могу, можешь, может, ... могут.

человек.analysis: M. animate noun, 'person/human'. Uses suppletive plural люди ('people') in most cases.

такой.analysis: Demonstrative adj., 'such/this kind of'. Used as an intensifier with adjectives (такой большой, 'so big'); agrees in gender, number, case.

его.analysis: Gen./acc. of он/оно; also the indeclinable possessive 'his/its'. The -го ending is pronounced 'vo' (ye-VÓ).

сказать.analysis: Perf. infinitive, 'to say/tell' (impf. говорить). Used for a single, completed act of speaking.

только.analysis: Adverb/particle, 'only/just'. Also forms time conjunctions like только что ('just now') and как только ('as soon as').

или.analysis: Coordinating conjunction, 'or'. Can be doubled (или... или..., 'either... or...').

бы.analysis: Conditional/subjunctive particle. Combines with past-tense verbs to form hypotheticals (я хотел бы, 'I would like').

себя.analysis: Reflexive pronoun, 'oneself'. Refers back to the subject of the clause; has no nominative form. Declines: себе, собой, о себе.

один.analysis: Numeral/determiner, 'one' (m. sg.); also 'alone' or 'a certain'. Declines like an adjective: f. одна, n. одно, pl. одни.

уже.analysis: Adverb, 'already/by now'. Marks that an action has occurred earlier than expected.

до.analysis: Preposition + gen., 'until/before/up to'. Marks a temporal or spatial limit (до вечера, 'until evening').

время.analysis: N. noun, 'time'. One of ten -мя neuters with an irregular stem extension (gen. времени, instr. временем).

если.analysis: Subordinating conjunction, 'if'. Introduces a conditional clause; often paired with the correlative то in the main clause.

сам.analysis: Emphatic pronoun, 'oneself/in person' (m. sg.). Stresses that the subject acts alone or personally; f. сама, n. само, pl. сами.

когда.analysis: Interrogative adverb and subordinating conjunction, 'when'. Introduces both questions and time clauses.

другой.analysis: Adjective/pronoun, 'other/another/different'. Declines like an adjective; agrees in gender, number, case.

вот.analysis: Presentative particle, 'here is/there is'. Points out something physically present or introduces a conclusion.

говорить.analysis: Impf. infinitive, 'to speak/say' (perf. сказать for a single act, поговорить for a brief chat).

наш.analysis: Possessive pronoun, 'our/ours' (m. sg.). Agrees with the possessed noun: f. наша, n. наше, pl. наши.

мой.analysis: Possessive pronoun, 'my/mine' (m. sg.). Agrees with the possessed noun: f. моя, n. моё, pl. мои.

знать.analysis: Impf. infinitive, 'to know' (a fact or person). For learning/finding out, use the perf. узнать.

стать.analysis: Perf. infinitive, 'to become' (impf. становиться). Governs instr. for the resulting state (стать врачом, 'to become a doctor').

при.analysis: Preposition + prep., 'at/in the presence of/under (conditions of)'. Often introduces circumstances (при этом, 'in addition to that').

чтобы.analysis: Subordinating conjunction of purpose, 'so that/in order to'. Followed by infinitive (same subject) or past tense (different subject).

дело.analysis: N. noun, 'matter/affair/business'. Common in set phrases: в чём дело? ('what's the matter?'), на самом деле ('actually').

жизнь.analysis: F. noun (3rd declension, soft sign), 'life'. Gen. sg. жизни.

кто.analysis: Interrogative/relative pronoun, 'who'. Always takes m. sg. agreement on verbs and adjectives, regardless of the actual referent.

первый.analysis: Ordinal numeral, 'first' (m. sg.). Declines like a regular adjective; agrees in gender, number, case.

очень.analysis: Intensifying adverb, 'very/extremely'. Modifies adjectives, adverbs, and verbs of feeling (очень хочу, 'I really want').

два.analysis: Cardinal numeral, 'two' (m./n.). Use две with f. nouns. Followed by gen. sg. (два дня, две минуты).

день.analysis: M. noun, 'day'. Fleeting vowel: the е drops in oblique cases (gen. sg. дня, dat. sg. дню).

новый.analysis: Adjective, 'new' (m. sg.). Regular hard-stem adjective; agrees in gender, number, case.

рука.analysis: F. noun, 'hand/arm'. Stress shifts to the stem in acc. sg. (рýку) and across the plural (рýки).

даже.analysis: Emphatic particle, 'even'. Placed before the word it intensifies to mark something unexpected.

во.analysis: Preposition, variant of в used before consonant clusters for easier pronunciation (во Франции, во вторник).

со.analysis: Preposition, variant of с used before consonant clusters (со мной, со стола).

раз.analysis: M. noun, 'time/occurrence'. Irregular gen. pl. раз (no ending) after numerals (пять раз, 'five times').

там.analysis: Adverb of location, 'there'. For direction ('to there'), use туда.

под.analysis: Preposition, 'under/below'. With acc. = direction 'under'; with instr. = location 'under' (под столом).

ну.analysis: Discourse particle/interjection, 'well/so'. Marks hesitation, prompting, or mild impatience in speech.

какой.analysis: Interrogative/exclamative adj., 'what kind of/which' (m. sg.). Agrees with its noun in gender, number, case.

после.analysis: Preposition + gen., 'after' (после обеда, 'after lunch'). Also used as an adverb meaning 'afterwards'.

их.analysis: Gen./acc. of они; also the indeclinable possessive 'their/theirs'. After prepositions, the pronominal use becomes них.

работа.analysis: F. noun, 'work/job'. With на + prep. = 'at work' (на работе); with на + acc. = 'to work' (на работу).

без.analysis: Preposition + gen., 'without'. Also used in clock time for 'minutes to' the hour (без пяти десять, '9:55').

самый.analysis: Adjective, 'the most/the very' (m. sg.). Combined with adjectives to form analytic superlatives (самый большой, 'the biggest').

потом.analysis: Adverb of time, 'then/afterwards/later'. Marks the next event in a sequence.

надо.analysis: Impersonal predicate, 'it is necessary/one should'. Used with dat. + infinitive (мне надо идти); slightly more colloquial than нужно.

хотеть.analysis: Impf. infinitive, 'to want'. Irregular: stem alternates х/ч (хочу, хочешь, хочет, хотим, хотите, хотят).

слово.natural: Word; also a promise or speech.
слово.analysis: N. noun, 'word'. Also 'promise/given word' in set phrases (дать слово, 'to give one's word').

идти.analysis: Impf. infinitive, 'to go on foot' (unidirectional). Paired with multidirectional ходить.

большой.analysis: Adjective, 'big/large' (m. sg.). Stressed ending; suppletive comparative больше.

должен.analysis: Short-form adjective, 'must/obliged' (m. sg.). Agrees with subject: f. должна, n. должно, pl. должны; takes an infinitive.

место.analysis: N. noun, 'place/spot/seat'. Stress shifts to the ending in the plural (места́).

иметь.analysis: Impf. infinitive, 'to have/possess'. More formal than the everyday у + gen. construction; common in fixed expressions (иметь право, 'to have the right').

ничто.analysis: Negative pronoun, 'nothing'. Requires double negation: ничто не помогло ('nothing helped'). Acc. form ничего is far more common in speech.

тут.analysis: Adverb of location, 'here'. Colloquial counterpart to здесь; also marks immediacy in narration ('and right then').

лицо.analysis: N. noun, 'face'. In official style also 'person/individual' (физическое лицо, 'natural person').

каждый.analysis: Determiner/pronoun, 'each/every' (m. sg.). Declines like an adjective and agrees with its noun in gender, number, case.

друг.analysis: M. animate noun, 'friend'. Irregular nom. pl. друзья, gen. pl. друзей.

теперь.analysis: Adverb, 'now' (in contrast to before). Used for situations that have changed; сейчас is more about the immediate moment.

глаз.analysis: M. noun, 'eye'. Irregular nom. pl. глаза, gen. pl. глаз (no ending).

ни.analysis: Negative particle. Doubled in 'neither... nor' lists (ни... ни...) and forms negative pronouns (никто, ничто, никогда).

тоже.analysis: Adverb, 'also/too'. Used in affirmative parallel statements; in contrast clauses use также.

тогда.natural: Then; at that time; in that case.
тогда.analysis: Adverb of time, 'then/at that time'. Also serves as the correlative 'in that case' in conditional sentences (если... тогда...).

видеть.analysis: Impf. infinitive, 'to see' (perf. увидеть). 2nd-conjugation with stem alternation: вижу, видишь, видит.

вопрос.analysis: M. noun, 'question/issue'. Common phrase: задать вопрос ('to ask a question').

через.analysis: Preposition + acc. Spatial 'through/across' (через мост) and temporal 'in/after' a span (через час, 'in an hour').

да.analysis: Particle/conjunction. Affirmative 'yes'; colloquially also 'and' or 'but' linking clauses.

здесь.analysis: Adverb of place, 'here'. Slightly more bookish than the everyday тут.

дом.analysis: M. noun, 'house, home'. Stress shifts to the ending in the plural (дома́, домо́в).

потому.analysis: Adverb of cause, 'for that reason'. Usually paired with что to form the conjunction потому что ('because').

сторона.analysis: F. noun, 'side, direction'; also a 'party' in a dispute or agreement. Stress shifts: сто́рону in the accusative.

думать.analysis: Impf. verb, 'to think'. Takes о + prep. for the topic of thought (думать о работе).

сделать.analysis: Perf. of делать, 'to do, to make'. Used for a single completed action.

жить.analysis: Impf. verb, 'to live, to reside'. Irregular present stem жив- (живу, живёшь).

страна.analysis: F. noun, 'country, nation'. Stress shifts to the stem in the plural (стра́ны).

чем.analysis: Conjunction 'than' in comparisons; also the instrumental/prepositional of что ('with what', 'about what').

мир.analysis: M. noun with two meanings: 'world' and 'peace'. Context disambiguates.

об.analysis: Preposition 'about, concerning' (+ prep.). Variant of о used before words beginning with a vowel (об этом, об Анне).

случай.analysis: M. noun, 'case, incident, occasion'. Common in fixed phrases: в случае ('in case of'), на всякий случай ('just in case').

голова.analysis: F. noun, 'head'; figuratively 'mind, brains'. Stress shifts: го́лову in the accusative singular.

более.analysis: Adverb 'more', used in bookish comparatives (более важный 'more important'). Slightly more formal than больше.

делать.analysis: Impf. verb, 'to do, to make'. Perf. pair: сделать. Regular -ать conjugation (делаю, делаешь).

смотреть.analysis: Impf. verb, 'to look, to watch'. Takes на + acc. for the object looked at (смотреть на картину).

просто.analysis: Adverb/particle, 'simply, just'. Also the short-form neuter of простой ('it is simple').

конечно.analysis: Adverb/particle, 'of course, certainly'. The чн is pronounced /шн/: [конешно].

сила.analysis: F. noun, 'strength, force, power'. Also used in physics for 'force'.

конец.analysis: M. noun, 'end'. Fleeting vowel: drops е in oblique cases (конца, концу).

перед.analysis: Preposition + instr., 'in front of, before' (spatial or temporal). Takes the form передо before мной.

несколько.analysis: Indefinite numeral, 'several, a few'. Governs the genitive (несколько дней).

вид.analysis: M. noun with several senses: 'appearance, view', 'type/kind', and grammatical 'aspect' of a verb.

всегда.analysis: Adverb of frequency, 'always'. Stress on the final syllable: всегда́.

работать.analysis: Impf. verb, 'to work, to function'. Takes над + instr. for the project one works on (работать над книгой).

между.analysis: Preposition + instr., 'between, among'. Common in между прочим ('by the way').

три.analysis: Cardinal numeral 'three'. Governs the genitive singular (три дня, три книги).

понять.analysis: Perf. of понимать, 'to understand'. Irregular: пойму, поймёшь, past понял/поняла́.

пойти.analysis: Perf. of идти, 'to set off on foot'. Also used inceptively for natural events (пойти дождь 'the rain started').

спросить.analysis: Perf. of спрашивать, 'to ask (a question)'. Distinct from просить ('to request').

город.analysis: M. noun, 'city, town'. Stressed plural ending: города́.

дать.analysis: Perf. verb, 'to give'. Irregular conjugation: дам, дашь, даст, дадим, дадите, дадут.

также.analysis: Adverb 'also, as well'. More bookish than тоже; typically used to add a new fact, not a parallel actor.

никто.analysis: Negative pronoun, 'nobody'. Requires a double negative: никто не пришёл ('nobody came').

понимать.analysis: Impf. verb, 'to understand'. Perf. pair: понять.

получить.analysis: Perf. of получать, 'to receive, to get'. Conjugates получу, получишь.

отношение.analysis: N. noun, 'relation, attitude'. Plural отношения often means 'relationship' between people.

лишь.analysis: Restrictive particle/conjunction, 'only, just'. More literary than только.

второй.analysis: Ordinal numeral 'second'. Declines like an adjective and agrees with its noun.

именно.analysis: Emphatic particle/adverb, 'exactly, precisely, namely'. Singles out the word it modifies.

ваш.analysis: Possessive pronoun, 'your(s)' for plural or formal address. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the thing possessed.

хотя.analysis: Concessive conjunction, 'although, though'. Often paired with и for emphasis (хотя и устал).

сидеть.analysis: Impf. verb, 'to sit, to be sitting'. Conjugates сижу, сидишь (stem-final д → ж in 1sg).

над.analysis: Preposition + instr., 'over, above'. Also used figuratively: работать над ('to work on').

оказаться.natural: To turn out; to find oneself.
оказаться.analysis: Perf. reflexive verb, 'to turn out (to be), to end up'. Often used with instr. complement (оказался врачом 'turned out to be a doctor').

взять.analysis: Perf. of брать, 'to take'. Irregular: возьму, возьмёшь.

прийти.analysis: Perf. of приходить, 'to arrive on foot'. Irregular: приду, придёшь, past пришёл/пришла.

являться.natural: To be; to constitute; to appear (formal).
являться.analysis: Impf. reflexive verb, formal copula 'to be'. Takes the instrumental for the predicate (является директором).

деньги.analysis: Plurale tantum, 'money'. Genitive plural: де́нег. No singular form.

почему.analysis: Interrogative adverb, 'why'. Answers typically use потому что ('because').

вдруг.analysis: Adverb, 'suddenly, all at once'. Also used in tentative questions: 'what if' (вдруг он опоздает).

любить.analysis: Impf. verb, 'to love, to like'. Conjugates люблю, любишь (л-insertion in 1sg).

почти.analysis: Adverb of approximation, 'almost, nearly'. Modifies adjectives, adverbs, or quantities.

стоить.analysis: Impf. verb, 'to cost, to be worth'. In impersonal constructions стоит + infinitive means 'it's worth doing'.

земля.analysis: F. noun, 'earth, land, soil'. Capitalised Земля denotes the planet.

ведь.analysis: Discourse particle, 'after all, you know'. Appeals to shared knowledge or supplies a reason.

общий.analysis: Adjective, 'common, shared, general'. Soft-stem declension after ш.

машина.analysis: F. noun, primarily 'car' in everyday speech; also 'machine' more broadly.

однако.analysis: Adversative conjunction/particle, 'however, but'. More formal than но.

сразу.analysis: Adverb, 'at once, immediately, straight away'. Often combined with же for emphasis (сразу же).

хорошо.analysis: Adverb/predicative, 'well, fine'. Also serves as a standalone 'okay' in agreement.

отец.analysis: M. noun, 'father'. Fleeting vowel: drops е in oblique cases (отца, отцу).

остаться.analysis: Perf. reflexive verb, 'to remain, to be left over'. Conjugates останусь, останешься.

выйти.analysis: Perf. of выходить, 'to exit on foot'. Takes из + gen. for the place exited (выйти из дома).

много.analysis: Adverb/quantifier, 'many, much, a lot'. Governs the genitive (много времени, много людей).

проблема.analysis: F. noun, 'problem, issue'. Borrowed but follows the regular 1st-declension pattern.

начать.analysis: Perf. of начинать, 'to begin'. Irregular: начну, начнёшь, past начал/начала́.

час.analysis: M. noun, 'hour'; also used for clock time (в час 'at one o'clock'). After 2/3/4 the form часа́ is used (два часа́).

право.analysis: N. noun, 'right' (entitlement) or 'law' (the discipline). Plural права́ also means 'driver's licence'.

совсем.analysis: Adverb of degree, 'completely, entirely'. With a negation it means 'not at all' (совсем не понимаю).

нога.analysis: F. noun, 'leg' or 'foot' (Russian does not strictly distinguish). Stress shifts: но́гу in the accusative singular.

главный.analysis: Adjective, 'main, principal, chief'. Common in titles like главный врач ('chief physician').

считать.analysis: Impf. verb, 'to count'; also 'to consider, to regard as' with an instrumental complement (считать его другом).

решение.analysis: N. noun, 'decision' or 'solution'. Verbal noun from решать/решить.

увидеть.natural: To see; to catch sight of.
увидеть.analysis: Perf. of видеть, 'to see, to catch sight of'. Emphasises a single moment of perception.

дверь.analysis: F. noun (3rd declension), 'door'. Instr. sg. дверью.

казаться.analysis: Impf. reflexive verb, 'to seem'. Often impersonal with dative: мне кажется ('it seems to me').

образ.analysis: M. noun, 'image, figure'; also 'way, manner' in phrases like таким образом ('in this way').

история.analysis: F. noun, 'history' (the discipline) or 'story, episode'. Context disambiguates.

писать.analysis: Impf. verb, 'to write'. Conjugates пишу, пишешь (stem-final с → ш).

лучший.analysis: Adjective, superlative of хороший: 'best'. Also used as the comparative 'better' in formal style.

власть.analysis: F. noun (3rd declension), 'power, authority'. Plural власти often denotes 'the authorities' (the government).

закон.analysis: M. noun, 'law'. Used for a specific statute or for law as a body of rules.

голос.analysis: M. noun, 'voice'; in politics, 'vote'. Stressed plural ending: голоса́.

найти.analysis: Perf. of находить, 'to find'. Irregular: найду, найдёшь, past нашёл/нашла.

поэтому.analysis: Adverb of consequence, 'therefore, that's why'. Introduces the result clause after a stated cause.

стоять.analysis: Impf. verb, 'to stand, to be standing'. Conjugates стою, стоишь.

вообще.analysis: Adverb, 'in general, generally'. With a negation often means 'not at all' (вообще не знаю).

тысяча.analysis: Cardinal numeral 'thousand'; declines as a feminine noun. Governs the genitive plural (тысяча рублей).

больше.analysis: Comparative adverb of много and большой: 'more, bigger'. Governs the genitive in comparisons (больше денег).

вместе.analysis: Adverb, 'together'. Takes с + instr. for the partner (вместе с другом).

маленький.analysis: Adjective, 'small, little'. Comparative: меньше; suppletive superlative: самый маленький.

некоторый.analysis: Indefinite pronoun/adjective, 'some, certain'. Declines like an adjective and agrees with its noun.

решить.analysis: Perf. of решать, 'to decide' or 'to solve' (a problem). Conjugates решу, решишь.

любой.analysis: Pronoun/adjective, 'any (one you like)'. Implies free choice; contrast with всякий ('every').

возможность.analysis: F. noun (3rd declension), 'possibility, opportunity'. Often paired with иметь ('to have an opportunity').

ночь.analysis: F. noun (3rd declension), 'night'. Common in the greeting спокойной ночи ('good night').

результат.analysis: M. noun, 'result, outcome'. Often used with в результате ('as a result of' + gen.).

стол.analysis: M. noun, 'table, desk'. End-stressed in oblique cases: стола́, столу́.

имя.analysis: N. noun, 'name' (first name). One of ten irregular neuter nouns in -мя (gen. имени, instr. именем).

никогда.analysis: Negative adverb, 'never'. Requires a double negative: никогда не был ('was never').

молодой.analysis: Adjective, 'young'. End-stressed in the masculine singular (молодо́й).

область.analysis: F. noun (3rd declension), 'region, area'; also an administrative 'oblast'. Figuratively 'field, sphere' (область науки).

например.analysis: Adverb, 'for example, for instance'. Typically set off by commas in writing.

пройти.analysis: Perf. of проходить, 'to pass, to go through'. Irregular: пройду, пройдёшь, past прошёл/прошла.

оно.analysis: Personal pronoun, 3rd sg. neuter, 'it'. Used to refer to neuter nouns (письмо → оно).

статья.analysis: F. noun, 'article' (in a publication); also a 'clause' of a law or contract.

число.analysis: N. noun, 'number'; also 'date' (какое сегодня число? 'what's the date today?'). Grammatically also 'number' (sg./pl.).

компания.analysis: F. noun, 'company' (a business); also a group of friends. Not to be confused with кампания ('campaign').

про.analysis: Preposition + acc., 'about, concerning'. Colloquial variant of о/об (фильм про войну).

государственный.analysis: Adjective, 'state, governmental, national'. Relational adjective derived from государство.

полный.analysis: Adjective, 'full, complete'. Of people it can also mean 'plump'.

принять.natural: To accept; to take; to adopt.
принять.analysis: Perf. of принимать, 'to accept, to take, to adopt'. Irregular: приму, примешь, past принял/приняла́.

народ.analysis: M. noun, 'people, folk, nation'. Grammatically singular but semantically collective; verbs agree in the singular.

никакой.analysis: Negative pronoun/adjective, 'no, not any'. Requires a double negative: никакой проблемы нет ('there's no problem at all').

жена.analysis: F. noun, 'wife'. Stress shifts to the stem in the plural (жёны).

настоящий.analysis: Adjective, 'real, genuine'; also 'present' in time (настоящее время 'present tense').

всякий.analysis: Pronoun/adjective, 'every, all kinds of'. Stresses variety; contrast with любой ('any one you pick').

группа.analysis: F. noun, 'group'. Note the doubled п in spelling.

развитие.analysis: N. noun, 'development, growth'. Verbal noun from развивать/развить.

процесс.analysis: M. noun, 'process'; also 'legal proceedings, trial' in formal usage.

давать.analysis: Impf. of дать, 'to give'. Conjugates даю, даёшь (stem -ва- drops in the present tense).

суд.analysis: M. noun, 'court, trial'. End-stressed in oblique cases: суда́, суду́.

ответить.analysis: Perf. of отвечать, 'to answer, to respond'. Takes на + acc. for the question answered (ответить на вопрос).

старый.analysis: Adjective, 'old' (of things or people). Comparative: старше (people) or старее (things).

условие.analysis: N. noun, 'condition, stipulation'. Plural условия often means '(living/working) conditions'.

твой.analysis: Possessive pronoun, 'your(s)' for informal singular address. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the thing possessed.

пока.analysis: Adverb/conjunction, 'while, for now, so long as'. Also a casual goodbye, 'bye'.

средство.analysis: N. noun, 'means, method, remedy'. Plural средства also means 'funds, resources'.

помнить.analysis: Impf. verb, 'to remember, to keep in mind'. Takes о + prep. for the thing remembered (помнить о матери).

начало.analysis: N. noun, 'beginning, start'. Verbal noun from начать/начинать.

ждать.analysis: Impf. verb, 'to wait, to expect'. Takes the genitive for abstract objects (ждать ответа) and accusative for specific people (ждать брата).

свет.analysis: M. noun, 'light'; also 'world' in fixed expressions (на свете, по свету).

пора.analysis: F. noun, 'time/season'. Common as a predicate: 'пора + infinitive' means 'it is time to ...'.

душа.analysis: F. noun, 'soul'. Stress shifts in accusative sg. (ду́шу) and in plural forms.

путь.analysis: M. noun, 'way/path/route'. Irregular: declines like a feminine soft-stem noun except in instrumental sg. (путём).

куда.analysis: Directional adverb, 'where to'. Contrast with где (location) and откуда (source).

разный.analysis: Adjective, 'different/various'. Usually used in the plural to mean 'assorted, of various kinds'.

нужный.analysis: Adjective, 'needed/necessary'. The short form (нужен, нужна, нужно, нужны) is common in predicates with a dative subject.

уровень.analysis: M. noun, 'level'. Drops the fleeting -е- in oblique cases (уровня, уровню).

иной.analysis: Adjective/pronoun, 'other/different'. More bookish than другой and often implies 'a different kind'.

связь.analysis: F. noun, 'connection/link'; also 'communications' in technical contexts.

кроме.analysis: Preposition + genitive, 'except/besides'. Often paired with того in the phrase кроме того ('moreover').

минута.analysis: F. noun, 'minute'. Numerals govern case: 2–4 минуты, 5+ минут.

находиться.natural: To be located; to be situated.
находиться.analysis: Impf. reflexive verb (perf. находиться/оказаться). Default verb for stating where a place or object is located.

опять.analysis: Adverb, 'again'. Interchangeable with снова in most contexts; slightly more colloquial.

многий.analysis: Adjective/pronoun, 'many'. Used mostly in the plural (многие люди) or in fixed neuter forms (многое).

белый.analysis: Adjective, 'white'. Agrees in gender, number, and case with its noun.

собственный.analysis: Adjective, 'own'. Stronger and more formal than свой; often emphasizes 'one's very own/personal'.

улица.analysis: F. noun, 'street'. The phrase на улице means both 'on the street' and 'outside/outdoors'.

написать.analysis: Perf. infinitive of писать (impf., 'to write'). Conjugates напишу, напишешь, напишет.

вечер.analysis: M. noun, 'evening'. Nominative plural takes stressed -а: вечера́.

снова.analysis: Adverb, 'again/anew'. Slightly more neutral or written-register than опять.

качество.analysis: N. noun, 'quality'. The phrase в качестве + gen. means 'in the capacity of/as'.

мысль.analysis: F. noun (soft-stem in -ь), 'thought/idea'. Plural мысли often translates as 'one's thoughts'.

дорога.analysis: F. noun, 'road/way'; also 'journey, trip' (в дороге = 'on the road').

мать.analysis: F. noun, 'mother'. Irregular: oblique stem adds -ер- (матери, матерью, матерей).

действие.analysis: N. noun, 'action/act'; also 'effect' (e.g., of a drug) and 'act' of a play.

месяц.analysis: M. noun, 'month'; also 'moon/crescent' in poetic use.

оставаться.analysis: Impf. reflexive verb (perf. остаться). Used for both physical staying and 'to remain (in a state)'.

государство.analysis: N. noun, 'state' in the political sense; not interchangeable with страна (country).

язык.analysis: M. noun. Two senses: 'language' and the anatomical 'tongue'. Stress shifts to ending in oblique cases (языка́).

взгляд.analysis: M. noun, 'glance/gaze'; figuratively 'view/opinion' (на мой взгляд = 'in my view').

любовь.analysis: F. noun, 'love'. Drops the fleeting -о- in oblique cases (любви, любовью).

мама.analysis: F. noun, 'mom/mum'. Affectionate everyday term; мать is the neutral/formal counterpart.

играть.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. сыграть). Takes в + acc. for games (в шахматы) and на + prep. for instruments (на гитаре).

лежать.analysis: Impf. verb of position (perf. полежать). Conjugates лежу, лежишь, лежат.

нельзя.analysis: Impersonal predicate, 'it is not allowed/one cannot'. With impf. = forbidden; with perf. = impossible.

век.analysis: M. noun, 'century'; also 'age/era' or colloquially 'a (very) long time'.

подумать.analysis: Perf. of думать. The по- prefix here marks a short, bounded act of thinking.

уйти.analysis: Perf. of уходить, 'to leave (on foot)'. Conjugates уйду, уйдёшь; past ушёл, ушла.

цель.analysis: F. noun, 'goal/aim'; also 'target' in literal contexts.

школа.analysis: F. noun, 'school'. Refers to primary/secondary school; higher education is университет or институт.

общество.analysis: N. noun, 'society'; also 'company' in the sense of being in someone's presence.

здравствуйте.analysis: Formal greeting used with strangers, elders, or in plural address. The first в is silent.

пожи.analysis: Colloquial clipping from поживаешь ('how are you doing'). Very informal, used between close peers.

здрасьте.analysis: Colloquial contraction of здравствуйте. Common in fast everyday speech.

чё.analysis: Informal/slang variant of что. Used heavily in casual spoken Russian; avoid in writing.

норм.analysis: Colloquial clipping of нормально, 'fine/okay'. Used as a neutral response to 'как дела?'.

пойдёт.analysis: 3sg future of пойти used as a colloquial predicate meaning 'acceptable, good enough'.

медведь.analysis: M. animate noun, 'bear'. Animate, so accusative sg. matches genitive (медведя).

завтрак.analysis: M. noun, 'breakfast'. The verb 'to have breakfast' is завтракать (impf.).

обед.analysis: M. noun, 'lunch/midday meal'. Traditionally the main hot meal of the day, eaten between 1 and 3 PM.

ужин.analysis: M. noun, 'supper/evening meal'. The corresponding verb is ужинать (impf.).

вкусно.analysis: Adverb/predicate, 'tasty/deliciously'. Common as a one-word reaction after eating.

счёт.analysis: M. noun, 'bill/account/score'. In restaurants: 'Счёт, пожалуйста' = 'The bill, please'.

направо.analysis: Directional adverb, 'to the right'. Pairs with налево (left) and прямо (straight).

налево.analysis: Directional adverb, 'to the left'. Also appears in the idiom ходить налево, 'to be unfaithful'.

прямо.analysis: Adverb, 'straight/directly'. In directions = 'straight ahead'; figuratively = 'frankly, outright'.

карта.analysis: F. noun with multiple senses: 'map', 'playing card', and 'bank/payment card'. Context disambiguates.

метро.analysis: N. noun, 'metro/subway'. Indeclinable loanword; endings never change.

остановка.analysis: F. noun, 'stop' for buses/trams; also 'pause/halt' in general.

вчера.analysis: Adverb of time, 'yesterday'. Triggers past-tense verbs.

завтра.analysis: Adverb of time, 'tomorrow'. Indeclinable; pairs with future-tense or perfective verbs.

извините.analysis: Polite/plural imperative of извинить. Used to apologize or to get a stranger's attention.

могу.analysis: 1sg present of мочь (impf., 'to be able'). Followed by an infinitive; expresses ability or possibility.

корзины.analysis: Nom./acc. pl. (or gen. sg.) of корзина (f. noun, 'basket').

лежат.analysis: 3pl present of лежать (impf., 'to lie/be lying'). Describes the position of multiple objects.

ключи.analysis: Nom./acc. pl. of ключ (m. noun). Senses: 'key', 'spring/source of water', and 'clue'.

кошелёк.analysis: M. noun, 'wallet/purse'. Drops the fleeting -ё- in oblique cases (кошелька, кошельку).

полотенце.analysis: N. noun, 'towel'. Genitive plural is irregular: полотенец.

моя.analysis: F. nom. sg. of the possessive мой ('my'). Agrees with a feminine singular noun.

мыло.analysis: N. noun, 'soap'. Treated as uncountable; for individual bars use кусок мыла.

тележки.analysis: Nom./acc. pl. (or gen. sg.) of тележка (f. noun, 'cart/trolley').

нужны.analysis: Short-form plural of нужный, 'needed'. Pattern: dative subject + нужны + nominative plural item.

чистое.analysis: N. nom./acc. sg. of чистый, 'clean/pure'. Agrees with a neuter singular noun.

можно.analysis: Impersonal predicate, 'one may/it is possible'. Used to ask permission: 'Можно + infinitive?'.

круто.analysis: Adverb/predicate. Literal sense 'steeply'; in colloquial use 'cool/awesome' as a positive reaction.

давай.natural: Let's go / Come on / OK / Bye.
давай.analysis: Imperative of давать. Multipurpose: forms 'let's' constructions, urges action, and signs off informal calls.

зарядка.analysis: F. noun with two everyday senses: a phone charger/charging cable and a short morning workout.

пакет.analysis: M. noun, 'bag/package'. In stores typically refers to a plastic shopping bag (usually paid).

пиво.analysis: N. noun, 'beer'. Treated as uncountable; for a serving use бокал/кружка пива.

идите.analysis: Formal/plural imperative of идти ('to go on foot'). Used when directing a stranger or a group.

среди.analysis: Preposition + genitive, 'among/amidst'. Used both spatially and figuratively (среди друзей, среди прочего).

деятельность.analysis: F. noun (soft-stem in -ь), 'activity/operations'. More formal than работа; common in official contexts.

посмотреть.analysis: Perf. of смотреть ('to look/watch'). Takes на + acc. for 'look at'; direct acc. for 'watch (a film)'.

организация.analysis: F. noun, 'organization'; also the act of organizing/arranging something.

вернуться.analysis: Perf. reflexive verb (impf. возвращаться), 'to return/come back'. Intransitive: the subject returns.

комната.analysis: F. noun, 'room' (inside a building). Larger spaces use зал or помещение.

порядок.analysis: M. noun, 'order/arrangement'. Drops the fleeting -о- in oblique cases (порядка, порядку).

момент.analysis: M. noun, 'moment/instant'; also 'aspect, point' (важный момент = 'an important point').

следовать.natural: To follow; to be supposed to.
следовать.analysis: Impf. verb, takes dative ('follow someone/something'). Impersonally следует + inf. = 'one should'.

театр.analysis: M. noun, 'theater'. Use в театре for the location ('at the theater').

письмо.analysis: N. noun, 'letter' (correspondence). Stress shifts to the stem in plural (пи́сьма).

читать.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. прочитать/прочесть), 'to read'. Conjugates regularly: читаю, читаешь, читают.

подобный.analysis: Adjective, 'similar/such'. Takes dative for what is being compared (подобный отцу = 'like the father').

следующий.analysis: Adjective (present active participle of следовать), 'next/following'. Standard for sequencing.

утро.analysis: N. noun, 'morning'. Time-of-day adverb is утром ('in the morning', instrumental).

особенно.analysis: Adverb, 'especially/particularly'. Used to single out one item from a set.

помощь.analysis: F. noun (soft-stem in -ь), 'help/assistance'. Common with prepositions: на помощь, с помощью + gen.

ситуация.analysis: F. noun, 'situation/circumstances'. Standard nouns in -ция decline regularly.

роль.analysis: F. noun (soft-stem in -ь), 'role/part'. Common phrase: играть роль ('to play a role/matter').

бывать.analysis: Impf. iterative of быть, used for habitual or occasional being/visiting (он бывает здесь часто).

ходить.analysis: Impf. multidirectional verb of motion. Pairs with unidirectional идти; used for habitual or round-trip motion.

начинать.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. начать), 'to begin/start'. Takes an accusative object or an imperfective infinitive.

рубль.analysis: M. noun, 'ruble'. Numerals govern case: 1 рубль, 2–4 рубля, 5+ рублей.

появиться.analysis: Perf. reflexive verb (impf. появляться), 'to appear/show up'. Conjugates появлюсь, появишься.

смысл.analysis: M. noun, 'meaning/sense/point'. Common: в смысле ('meaning/i.e.'), нет смысла ('there's no point').

состояние.analysis: N. noun, 'state/condition'; also 'fortune/wealth' in some contexts.

называть.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. назвать), 'to call/name'. Takes a double accusative: называть кого/что кем/чем.

рядом.analysis: Adverb, 'nearby'. With с + instrumental means 'next to' (рядом с домом).

квартира.analysis: F. noun, 'apartment/flat'. Use в квартире for location.

назад.analysis: Adverb, 'back/backwards'. After a time expression means 'ago' (два года назад = 'two years ago').

равный.analysis: Adjective, 'equal'. Takes dative for the thing equaled (равный нулю = 'equal to zero').

орган.analysis: M. noun, 'organ' (body part) or 'agency/body' (official). The musical instrument is орга́н with end stress.

внимание.analysis: N. noun, 'attention/notice'. Common with verbs обращать/уделять внимание ('to pay attention').

прийтись.natural: To have to; to be suitable.
прийтись.analysis: Perf. reflexive verb (impf. приходиться). In the impersonal past (пришлось + dat. + inf.) = 'had to'.

тело.analysis: N. noun, 'body'. Stress shifts to the ending in plural (тела́, тел).

труд.analysis: M. noun, 'labor/work/effort'. More abstract than работа; common in formal/economic contexts.

сын.analysis: M. animate noun, 'son'. Irregular nom. plural сыновья (gen. pl. сыновей).

хотеться.analysis: Impersonal reflexive verb. Pattern: dative subject + хочется + inf./noun (мне хочется спать).

мера.analysis: F. noun, 'measure/degree/extent'. Common in fixed phrases: в меру ('in moderation'), по мере + gen. ('as').

пять.analysis: Cardinal numeral, 'five'. Governs the genitive plural of the counted noun (пять книг).

смерть.analysis: F. noun (soft-stem in -ь), 'death'. Instrumental sg. is смертью; common in fixed phrases (до смерти).

программа.analysis: F. noun, 'program/plan'; also a TV show or a computer program depending on context.

рынок.analysis: M. noun, 'market'. Drops the fleeting -о- in oblique cases (рынка, рынку).

задача.analysis: F. noun, 'task/problem'. Used for assigned tasks and for math/logic problems.

предприятие.analysis: N. noun, 'enterprise/company'; also 'undertaking, venture' in a more abstract sense.

известный.analysis: Adjective, 'known/famous'. Short form известен/известна takes dative for who knows (известен всем).

окно.analysis: N. noun, 'window'. Stress shifts to the stem in plural (о́кна, о́кон).

вести.analysis: Impf. unidirectional verb of motion, 'to lead/conduct'. Multidirectional pair водить; perf. повести.

совершенно.analysis: Adverb, 'completely/absolutely'. Often intensifies adjectives (совершенно новый = 'brand new').

показать.analysis: Perf. of показывать, 'to show/demonstrate'. Conjugates покажу, покажешь, покажет.

правительство.analysis: N. noun, 'government' (the executive body). Distinct from государство ('state').

разговор.analysis: M. noun, 'conversation/talk'. The related verb is разговаривать ('to converse').

важный.analysis: Adjective, 'important/significant'. Short form важен/важна common in predicate use.

семья.analysis: F. noun, 'family'. Stress shifts: nom. sg. семья́, gen. pl. семе́й (with -е- inserted).

великий.analysis: Adjective, 'great/grand'. Used for figures of historical significance; not for physical size.

производство.analysis: N. noun, 'production/manufacturing'; also a factory floor in everyday speech (на производстве).

значит.analysis: 3sg present of значить (impf., 'to mean'). Common as a discourse marker meaning 'so' or 'therefore'.

простой.analysis: Adjective, m. nom. sg. ('simple, plain'). Hard-stem; short form прост, проста, просто, просты.

третий.analysis: Ordinal numeral, m. nom. sg. Declines with a soft -ь- stem (третьего, третьему).

давно.natural: Long ago; for a long time.
давно.analysis: Adverb of time. With past tense means 'long ago'; with present tense, 'for a long time (still ongoing)'.

огромный.analysis: Adjective, m. nom. sg. Stronger than большой; used for size and figurative scale (огромное значение).

политический.analysis: Relational adjective from политика. Used for spheres or actors (политическая партия), not human qualities.

действительно.analysis: Adverb/parenthetical, 'really, indeed'. Confirms a claim; often set off by commas as a parenthetical.

информация.analysis: F. noun, 'information'. Usually singular; takes о + prep. for 'information about' (информация о событии).

положение.analysis: N. noun. Covers physical position, social status, and abstract 'situation' (международное положение).

бояться.analysis: Impf. reflexive verb. Governs the genitive (бояться собаки) or an infinitive (бояться сказать).

поставить.analysis: Perf. of ставить ('to put upright'). Use for placing something standing, or for setting tasks, plays, signatures.

наконец.analysis: Adverb, 'at last'. Variant наконец-то adds emotional relief; often used as a parenthetical.

центр.analysis: M. noun. Common in spatial ('центр города') and institutional senses ('научный центр').

происходить.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. произойти). Also means 'to originate, descend from' (происходить из семьи).

муж.analysis: M. noun, 'husband'. Irregular plural мужья, мужей; archaic sense 'man' survives in мужи науки.

ответ.analysis: M. noun, 'answer'. Common collocations: дать ответ, в ответ на + acc.

автор.analysis: M. noun. Used for authors of texts, ideas, or actions; takes genitive (автор книги).

интерес.analysis: M. noun. Takes к + dative ('интерес к музыке'); plural интересы means 'concerns, interests'.

стена.analysis: F. noun, 'wall'. Stress shifts in pl. (сте́ны), and accusative sg. is colloquially сте́ну or стену́.

существовать.analysis: Impf. verb, 'to exist'. -овать stem alternates to -у- in conjugation (существую, существуешь).

правило.analysis: N. noun. The fixed phrase 'как правило' means 'as a rule, usually'.

становиться.analysis: Impf. of стать. Takes instrumental for the new state (становиться врачом).

федерация.analysis: F. noun. Used officially in Российская Федерация; abbreviated РФ.

оба.analysis: Numeral 'both' for m./n. nouns (f. is обе). Declines and governs gen. sg. (оба брата).

часто.analysis: Adverb of frequency. Comparative чаще; pairs naturally with imperfective verbs.

управление.analysis: N. noun. Governs instrumental ('управление компанией') and names admin bodies (Управление делами).

быстро.analysis: Adverb of manner, from быстрый. Comparative быстрее.

слышать.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. услышать). 2nd-conjugation despite the -ать ending; passive perception, vs. active слушать.

смочь.analysis: Perf. of мочь. Refers to a single successful instance of being able (смогу, сможешь, смог).

заметить.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. замечать). Also used to introduce a remark ('замечу, что...').

долго.analysis: Adverb of duration, from долгий. Comparative дольше; emphasizes process length, not point in past.

мужчина.analysis: Masculine noun with feminine -а ending; declines like a f. noun but takes m. agreement (этот мужчина пришёл).

правда.analysis: F. noun, 'truth'. Also a parenthetical meaning 'true, indeed' or a tag question ('правда?').

идея.analysis: F. noun, 'idea'. Collocation 'по идее' means 'in theory, supposedly'.

иногда.analysis: Adverb of frequency, 'sometimes'. Pairs with imperfective verbs.

использовать.analysis: Biaspectual verb: same form serves impf. and perf. Governs the accusative (использовать инструмент).

готовый.analysis: Adjective, m. nom. sg. Short form готов is common predicatively ('я готов'); takes к + dative.

пытаться.analysis: Impf. reflexive verb (perf. попытаться). Takes an infinitive complement (пытаться понять).

зачем.analysis: Interrogative adverb asking purpose ('for what'); contrast with почему, which asks for cause.

чуть.analysis: Adverb/particle. 'чуть не' + verb means 'almost' (чуть не упал, 'almost fell').

представить.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. представлять). With себе means 'to imagine'; without, 'to present, introduce'.

чувствовать.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. почувствовать). Silent в in pronunciation: ['чустваватʲ]. Often reflexive: чувствовать себя 'to feel (oneself)'.

совет.analysis: M. noun. Two senses: 'advice' (дать совет) and 'council' (Совет Безопасности).

создать.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. создавать). Irregular conjugation: создам, создашь, создаст.

движение.analysis: N. noun. Senses range from physical motion to road traffic (правила движения) and social movements.

сердце.analysis: N. noun, 'heart'. Silent 'д' in pronunciation: ['серце]. Pl. nom. сердца́.

вещь.analysis: F. noun ending in soft -щь, 3rd declension. Concrete 'thing/object' or abstract 'matter' (странная вещь).

материал.analysis: M. noun. Covers physical material, fabric, and journalistic/research source material.

неделя.analysis: F. noun, 'week'. 'На неделе' = 'during the week'; 'через неделю' = 'in a week'.

чувство.analysis: N. noun. Covers both emotions (чувство любви) and physical senses (пять чувств); silent в in pronunciation.

данный.analysis: Past passive participle of дать, used adjectivally to mean 'this, the present'. Formal register: в данный момент.

заниматься.natural: To be engaged in; to do regularly.
заниматься.analysis: Impf. reflexive verb. Governs instrumental for the activity (заниматься спортом, музыкой).

затем.analysis: Adverb of sequence, 'then, after that'. Slightly more formal than потом.

красный.analysis: Adjective, m. nom. sg., 'red'. Originally meant 'beautiful' (Красная площадь = Beautiful Square).

продолжать.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. продолжить). Takes an imperfective infinitive (продолжать работать).

глава.analysis: F. noun. Means 'chapter of a book' or 'leader' (глава государства); archaic for 'head' (anatomical = голова).

ко.analysis: Vocalized variant of preposition к, used before clusters that begin with the same consonant (ко мне, ко всему).

слушать.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. послушать). Active attention (vs. passive слышать); governs the accusative.

наука.analysis: F. noun. Broader than English 'science' — covers humanities too (гуманитарные науки).

газета.analysis: F. noun, 'newspaper'. From Italian gazzetta; preposition в + prep. for 'in the newspaper' (в газете).

ряд.analysis: M. noun. Phrase 'ряд + gen. pl.' means 'a number of' (ряд проблем). Loc. в ряду́ vs. в ря́де ('in a series of').

узнать.analysis: Perf. of узнавать. Two senses: 'to learn (a fact)' and 'to recognize (someone known)'.

причина.analysis: F. noun. Phrase 'по причине + gen.' = 'because of'; takes gen. complement (причина войны).

против.analysis: Preposition governing the genitive: 'against, opposite' (против ветра, против него).

плечо.analysis: N. noun. Irregular pl. nom. плечи, gen. плеч; common in idioms like 'на плечах' (on one's shoulders).

современный.analysis: Adjective from время. Also means 'contemporary to' + dat. (современный Пушкину).

цена.analysis: F. noun. Stress shifts to ending in oblique cases (цены́, цене́); acc. sg. це́ну keeps initial stress.

план.analysis: M. noun. Also 'plane, level' in compounds (на первом плане = in the foreground).

приехать.analysis: Perf. of приезжать. Vehicle-based motion; uses в/на + acc. for destination (приехать в Москву).

речь.analysis: F. noun, 3rd decl. Phrase 'речь идёт о + prep.' = 'it is about, the matter concerns'.

четыре.analysis: Cardinal numeral. Governs gen. sg. of the counted noun (четыре книги).

отвечать.analysis: Impf. of ответить. Takes на + acc. for 'answer (a question)'; with за + acc. means 'be responsible for'.

точка.analysis: F. noun, 'point/dot'. Phrase 'точка зрения' = 'point of view'; also the period mark in punctuation.

основа.analysis: F. noun. Phrase 'на основе + gen.' = 'on the basis of'; in linguistics, also a word stem.

товарищ.analysis: M. noun. Soviet-era address ('товарищ Иванов'); today mostly 'comrade, mate' in informal or nostalgic use.

вполне.analysis: Adverb of degree, 'fully, quite'. Often softens an evaluation (вполне хорошо, 'quite good').

далее.analysis: Comparative-form adverb, 'further'. Bookish equivalent of дальше; common in 'и так далее' ('and so on').

культура.analysis: F. noun. Covers 'culture' in the anthropological sense and 'cultivation/manners' (культура поведения).

рассказывать.natural: To tell; to narrate; to recount.
рассказывать.analysis: Impf. of рассказать. Takes о + prep. for the topic, dat. for the addressee (рассказывать другу о поездке).

слишком.analysis: Adverb of excess, 'too' (negative). Distinct from очень ('very'): слишком много = 'too much'.

данные.analysis: Plurale tantum from данный, used as a noun meaning 'data'. Declines as an adj. (данных, данным).

представлять.natural: To represent; to present; to imagine.
представлять.analysis: Impf. of представить. 'Представлять собой' = 'to constitute, be'; with себе means 'to imagine'.

рассказать.analysis: Perf. of рассказывать. Conveys a single completed narration; pairs with dat. of listener.

мнение.analysis: N. noun. Phrase 'по моему мнению' = 'in my opinion'; takes о + prep. for the topic.

около.analysis: Preposition governing the genitive. Spatial 'next to' (около дома) or approximate 'about' (около часа).

документ.analysis: M. noun. In plural 'документы' commonly refers to one's ID papers (предъявите документы).

институт.analysis: M. noun. Used both for academic institutes (МГИМО) and abstract institutions (институт брака).

ход.analysis: M. noun. Senses include physical movement, a game move, a passage/entrance (чёрный ход), and abstract 'course' (ход событий).

брать.natural: To take; to grab; to borrow.
брать.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. взять). Highly irregular: беру, берёшь, берут.

забыть.analysis: Perf. of забывать. Takes acc. for objects/facts or про + acc. ('забыть про встречу').

проект.analysis: M. noun. Also 'draft' in formal contexts (проект закона = draft law). Pronounced [праэкт].

ранний.analysis: Soft-stem adjective, m. nom. sg. Comparative раньше doubles as an adverb meaning 'earlier, formerly'.

встреча.analysis: F. noun. From встретить ('to meet'); covers planned meetings and chance encounters.

особый.analysis: Adjective, m. nom. sg. More formal than особенный; common in fixed phrases (особое мнение).

целый.analysis: Adjective, m. nom. sg. Used for emphasis on quantity (целый час = 'a whole hour') as well as integrity.

директор.analysis: M. noun. Pl. nom. директора́ (with stress shift), unlike many m. nouns.

плохой.analysis: Adjective, m. nom. sg. Comparative хуже (suppletive); short forms плох, плоха, плохо.

провести.natural: To conduct; to carry out; to spend (time).
провести.analysis: Perf. of проводить. Senses: spend (time), carry out (an event), lead through, draw (a line).

спать.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. поспать for 'sleep a bit'). Irregular: сплю, спишь, спят.

впрочем.analysis: Parenthetical conjunction signalling a mild reservation or switch ('then again, however'); set off by commas.

может.analysis: 3sg present of мочь ('can'). Also a parenthetical shortened from может быть ('maybe').

сильный.analysis: Adjective, m. nom. sg. Comparative сильнее; used for physical strength and intensity (сильный дождь).

наверное.analysis: Parenthetical adverb expressing probability; set off by commas. Often spelled наверно in speech.

скорый.analysis: Adjective, m. nom. sg. Fixed phrases: скорая помощь ('ambulance'), скорый поезд ('express train').

срок.analysis: M. noun. Covers a fixed time span, a deadline, or a prison sentence (отбывать срок).

опыт.analysis: M. noun. Means both 'life/work experience' and a scientific 'experiment' (поставить опыт).

палец.analysis: M. noun with fleeting -е- (gen. пальца). Same word for finger and toe; specify with на руке/на ноге.

помочь.analysis: Perf. of помогать. Governs the dative of the person helped (помочь другу).

приходить.analysis: Impf. of прийти; on-foot arrival. Fixed phrases: приходить в себя ('to come to'), приходить в голову ('to occur to').

крупный.analysis: Adjective, m. nom. sg. Emphasizes significance/scale, not just size (крупная компания, крупный учёный).

внутренний.analysis: Soft-stem adjective. Used for physical interior, internal affairs (МВД, министерство внутренних дел), and inner states.

вспомнить.analysis: Perf. of вспоминать. Takes acc. or о + prep. ('вспомнить о встрече'). Single act of recalling, not the state of remembering.

просить.natural: To ask; to request; to beg.
просить.analysis: Impf. of попросить. Asks for something (vs. спрашивать = ask a question); takes acc. of person + о + prep.

открыть.natural: To open; to uncover; to discover.
открыть.analysis: Perf. of открывать. Senses: open a door, discover (открыть Америку), reveal a secret.

привести.natural: To bring; to lead; to put in order.
привести.analysis: Perf. of приводить. On-foot 'bring (a person/animal)'; also abstract: привести к + dat. = 'to lead to (a result)'.

судьба.analysis: F. noun. Irregular pl. судьбы, судеб. Common idiom: 'судьба свела' ('fate brought together').

девушка.analysis: F. noun, 'young woman' (roughly teens to 30s). Also a polite address to a young waitress or shop assistant.

очередь.analysis: F. noun, 3rd decl. Phrase 'в свою очередь' = 'in turn'; 'в первую очередь' = 'first of all'.

поскольку.analysis: Subordinating conjunction giving reason, slightly more formal than потому что; introduces causal clauses.

лес.analysis: M. noun. Locative takes -у́ after в/на (в лесу́); pl. леса́ with end stress.

оставить.natural: To leave; to abandon; to keep.
оставить.analysis: Perf. of оставлять. Senses: leave behind, abandon, or keep for later (оставить на потом).

пусть.analysis: Particle forming 3rd-person imperatives ('пусть скажет' = 'let him say'); also concessive ('even if').

экономический.analysis: Relational adjective from экономика. Distinct from экономный ('thrifty, economical') applied to people.

правый.analysis: Adjective, m. nom. sg. Senses: right-hand side, politically right-wing, and (short form прав) 'correct, in the right'.

состав.analysis: M. noun. Phrase 'в составе + gen.' = 'as part of'; also means a train consist (railway).

словно.analysis: Comparative conjunction, 'as if, like'. Literary register; introduces similes (словно во сне).

федеральный.analysis: Relational adjective from федерация. Common in official names: федеральный закон, федеральный округ.

принимать.natural: To accept; to take; to admit; to host.
принимать.analysis: Impf. of принять. Wide range: take a decision (принимать решение), host guests, take medicine, accept an offer.

спрашивать.analysis: Impf. of спросить. Asks a question (vs. просить = request something); takes acc. of person, о + prep. of topic.

близкий.analysis: Adjective, m. nom. sg. Covers spatial closeness, temporal nearness, and emotional intimacy (близкий друг).

искать.analysis: Impf. verb. Conjugates with -щ- mutation: ищу, ищешь, ищут. Takes acc. for concrete objects, gen. for abstract things.

количество.analysis: N. noun. Takes gen. for the things counted (количество студентов); paired conceptually with качество ('quality').

похожий.analysis: Adjective, m. nom. sg. Takes на + acc. for what is resembled (похож на отца, 'looks like his father'); short form похож, похожа common.

событие.analysis: N. noun. Used for newsworthy or historically significant occurrences; pl. события often = 'developments, news'.

член.analysis: M. noun. 'Member' of a group (член семьи, член партии); also a body part, including the anatomical sense.

войти.analysis: Perf. of входить; on-foot entry. Takes в + acc. for the place; also 'log in' in computing (войти в систему).

зал.analysis: M. noun. Large room for a specific function: спортивный зал ('gym'), концертный зал ('concert hall').

объект.analysis: M. noun. Often a built site or facility (строительный объект); also philosophical/grammatical 'object'.

различный.analysis: Adjective, m. nom. sg. Slightly more formal than разный; often pl. ('различные мнения').

создание.analysis: N. noun from создать. Two senses: the act of creating, or a created being (often a person, esp. affectionately).

достаточно.analysis: Adverb of sufficiency. Used impersonally with gen. (достаточно времени) or as a degree modifier ('достаточно хорошо').

значение.analysis: N. noun, 'meaning, significance, value'. Common in academic and abstract contexts; takes genitive for what is meaningful.

назвать.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. называть), 'to name, call'. Takes acc. for the object and instrumental for the assigned name.

необходимый.analysis: Adjective, 'necessary, indispensable'. Stronger than нужный; the short form необходим is common in predicate use.

период.analysis: M. noun, 'period, span of time'. Often paired with в течение + gen. ('during the period of').

хоть.analysis: Concessive conjunction/particle. As conjunction: 'although'; as particle: 'at least, even'.

шаг.analysis: M. noun, 'step, pace'. Used literally for walking and figuratively for actions in a process (сделать шаг).

брат.analysis: M. noun, 'brother'. Irregular plural: братья, братьев.

искусство.analysis: N. noun, 'art, skill, craft'. Covers both fine art and acquired mastery of a craft.

произойти.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. происходить), 'to happen, occur'. Also means 'to originate from' (произойти от + gen.).

успеть.natural: To manage (in time); to be in time.
успеть.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. успевать), 'to manage in time'. Followed by infinitive or на/к + noun for the deadline.

выходить.natural: To go out; to exit; to come out.
выходить.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. выйти), 'to exit on foot'. Use из + gen. for the place exited.

единственный.analysis: Adjective, 'only, sole'. Emphasizes uniqueness; do not confuse with единый ('unified').

структура.analysis: F. noun, 'structure, framework'. Common in academic, organizational, and technical contexts.

исследование.analysis: N. noun, 'research, investigation'. Verbal noun from исследовать; common in academic contexts.

номер.analysis: M. noun, 'number; hotel room; issue of a periodical'. Plural takes stressed ending: номера́.

пить.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. выпить), 'to drink'. Irregular present: пью, пьёшь, пьёт.

предложить.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. предлагать), 'to offer, propose'. Takes dat. of recipient and acc. of what is offered.

пример.analysis: M. noun, 'example, instance'. Common in the phrase например ('for example').

глядеть.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. поглядеть), 'to look at'. Slightly more colloquial than смотреть; takes на + acc.

гражданин.analysis: M. noun, 'citizen'. Irregular plural: граждане, граждан; feminine form is гражданка.

игра.analysis: F. noun, 'game, play'. Stress shifts in plural: и́гры, игр.

начальник.analysis: M. noun, 'boss, chief, head'. Used for a direct superior in workplaces or organizations.

сей.analysis: Archaic/bookish demonstrative, 'this'. Survives in set phrases like сию минуту, до сих пор, на сей раз.

человеческий.analysis: Adjective, 'human, pertaining to people'. Distinguish from человечный ('humane, compassionate').

дорогой.analysis: Adjective, 'expensive; dear (beloved)'. Also a common form of address in letters: Дорогой друг.

ехать.analysis: Impf. unidirectional verb, 'to go by vehicle'. Pair with multidirectional ездить; perf. is поехать.

международный.analysis: Adjective, 'international'. Built from между ('between') + народ ('people, nation').

попасть.natural: To get (into); to end up; to hit.
попасть.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. попадать), 'to get into, end up; hit a target'. Use в + acc. for destination or target.

принцип.analysis: M. noun, 'principle, fundamental rule'. Common phrase: в принципе ('in principle, basically').

рост.analysis: M. noun, 'growth; height (of a person)'. Verbal noun from расти.

тема.analysis: F. noun, 'theme, topic, subject'. Standard term in academic and conversational contexts.

верить.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. поверить), 'to believe, trust'. Takes dat. of person or в + acc. for belief in something.

держать.analysis: Impf. verb, 'to hold, keep'. Second conjugation: держу, держишь, держат.

десять.analysis: Cardinal numeral, 'ten'. Governs gen. pl. (десять книг); declines like a feminine soft-stem noun.

метод.analysis: M. noun, 'method, technique'. Used in scientific, technical, and procedural contexts.

начаться.analysis: Perf. reflexive verb (impf. начинаться), 'to begin (intransitive)'. Subject is the event itself.

небольшой.analysis: Adjective, 'small, not large'. Softer/more neutral than маленький; written as one word.

тип.analysis: M. noun, 'type, kind'. Colloquially also 'guy, character', often with negative undertone.

фильм.analysis: M. noun, 'film, movie'. Loanword; кино is the broader term for cinema as medium or institution.

либо.analysis: Disjunctive conjunction, 'either ... or'. Typically doubled: либо ... либо. Also a particle in indefinite pronouns (кто-либо).

край.analysis: M. noun, 'edge, border; region (administrative)'. Locative form в краю vs. в крае differs by meaning.

позволять.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. позволить), 'to allow, permit'. Takes dat. of person and infinitive of action.

гость.analysis: M. noun, 'guest'. Common phrase: в гостях ('visiting'), в гости ('to visit').

купить.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. покупать), 'to buy'. Takes acc. of object and у + gen. for the seller.

менее.analysis: Comparative adverb, 'less'. Used in compound comparatives (менее интересный); bookish; меньше is used standalone.

местный.analysis: Adjective, 'local, of a place'. Derived from место; the т is silent in pronunciation.

собираться.natural: To gather; to get ready; to intend.
собираться.analysis: Impf. reflexive verb (perf. собраться), 'to gather; to intend, plan'. With infinitive: 'to plan to do'.

уходить.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. уйти), 'to leave on foot'. Use из/от + gen. for source; prefix у- implies departure.

бывший.analysis: Past active participle of быть used as adjective, 'former, ex-'. Often substantivized: бывший ('ex-partner').

воздух.analysis: M. noun, 'air, atmosphere'. Common phrase: на свежем воздухе ('outdoors, in fresh air').

относиться.analysis: Impf. reflexive verb (perf. отнестись), 'to treat, regard'. Takes к + dat. for the object of attitude.

туда.analysis: Directional adverb, 'to there'. Used with motion verbs; the static counterpart is там.

борьба.analysis: F. noun, 'struggle, fight, wrestling'. Use за + acc. ('for') or против + gen. ('against').

требовать.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. потребовать), 'to demand, require'. Typically takes gen. of what is demanded.

характер.analysis: M. noun, 'character, personality, nature'. Refers to disposition, not a fictional character (that is персонаж).

использование.analysis: N. noun, 'use, utilization'. Verbal noun from использовать; common in technical and formal contexts.

кстати.analysis: Parenthetical adverb, 'by the way, incidentally'. Set off by commas when introducing a digression.

подойти.natural: To come up; to approach; to fit/suit.
подойти.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. подходить), 'to approach; to suit'. Use к + dat. for what one approaches or suits.

образование.analysis: N. noun, 'education; formation'. Covers both schooling (высшее образование) and the act of forming.

размер.analysis: M. noun, 'size, dimension'. Used for clothing sizes, measurements, and abstract magnitudes.

удаться.natural: To succeed; to turn out well.
удаться.analysis: Perf. reflexive verb (impf. удаваться), 'to succeed'. Used impersonally with dat.: мне удалось ('I managed to').

кровь.analysis: F. noun (3rd declension), 'blood'. Stress shifts to ending in some forms: крови́, кровью́.

мальчик.analysis: M. noun, 'boy, male child'. Diminutive of an obsolete мальц; used for children up to early teens.

небо.analysis: N. noun, 'sky, heavens'. Irregular plural небеса, небес (literary/elevated register).

получать.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. получить), 'to receive, get'. Takes acc. of object and от + gen. for source.

район.analysis: M. noun, 'district, area, neighborhood'. Standard administrative subdivision in Russian cities.

класс.analysis: M. noun, 'class, grade (school), category'. Also used as exclamation: Класс! ('Cool!').

представитель.analysis: M. noun, 'representative, delegate'. Takes gen. of what is represented; feminine form is представительница.

участие.analysis: N. noun, 'participation'. Common phrase: принимать участие в + prep. ('to take part in').

девочка.analysis: F. noun, 'girl, female child'. Diminutive of дева; used for children up to early teens.

политика.analysis: F. noun, 'politics; policy'. Same form covers both abstract politics and a concrete policy.

сначала.analysis: Adverb, 'at first, initially; from the beginning'. Written as one word; do not confuse with с начала ('from the start of').

герой.analysis: M. noun, 'hero; protagonist'. Used both for heroic figures and fictional main characters.

картина.analysis: F. noun, 'picture, painting'. Also used figuratively for a scene or overall situation.

широкий.analysis: Adjective, 'wide, broad'. Used spatially and figuratively (широкий выбор, 'wide choice'); comparative: шире.

спина.analysis: F. noun, 'back (body part)'. Stress shifts: спина́ (nom. sg.) but спи́ну (acc. sg.).

территория.analysis: F. noun, 'territory, area'. Refers to a defined geographic or administrative space.

мировой.analysis: Adjective, 'world, global'. Derived from мир ('world'); colloquially мировой can mean 'great, excellent'.

пол.analysis: M. noun with two meanings: 'floor (surface)' and 'sex, gender'. Locative form: на полу (stressed ending).

довольно.analysis: Adverb, 'rather, quite; enough'. As intensifier modifies adjectives/adverbs; as predicate means 'that's enough'.

изменение.analysis: N. noun, 'change, alteration'. Verbal noun from изменить/изменять; formal register.

поле.analysis: N. noun, 'field, open land'. Also figurative: поле деятельности ('field of activity'); plural поля.

умереть.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. умирать), 'to die'. Irregular past: умер, умерла, умерло, умерли.

возможный.analysis: Adjective, 'possible, feasible'. Short form возможен/возможна is common in predicate use.

направление.analysis: N. noun, 'direction; course; field of study'. Used both spatially and for academic/professional specialization.

рисунок.analysis: M. noun, 'drawing, sketch; pattern (on fabric)'. Fleeting vowel о drops in oblique cases: рисунка.

течение.analysis: N. noun, 'flow, current'. Set phrase в течение + gen. means 'during, in the course of'.

церковь.analysis: F. noun (3rd declension), 'church (building or institution)'. Irregular: gen. sg. церкви, instr. sg. церковью.

банк.analysis: M. noun, 'bank (financial institution)'. Loanword; river bank is берег, not банк.

отдельный.analysis: Adjective, 'separate, individual'. Derived from отделить ('to separate'); often modifies countable units.

красивый.analysis: Adjective, 'beautiful, handsome'. Comparative: красивее. Applies to people, objects, and abstract qualities.

население.analysis: N. noun, 'population, inhabitants (collective)'. Verbal noun from населить ('to populate').

средний.analysis: Adjective, 'middle, average'. Soft-stem declension; used in fixed terms like средняя школа, средний род (grammar).

сцена.analysis: F. noun, 'stage (theater); scene (in a play or event)'. Loanword from Latin.

большинство.analysis: N. collective noun, 'majority'. Takes gen. pl. for the group (большинство людей); verb usually agrees in singular.

двадцать.analysis: Cardinal numeral, 'twenty'. Governs gen. pl. (двадцать книг); declines as a single word.

короткий.analysis: Adjective, 'short, brief'. Refers to length in space or time; comparative: короче.

музыка.analysis: F. noun, 'music'. Used only in singular; instrumental form is музыкой.

свежеее.analysis: Comparative form of свежий, 'fresher, more recent'. Used both for food and figuratively for news/ideas.

есть.natural: To eat; also used in basic possession.
есть.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. съесть), 'to eat'. Irregular conjugation: ем, ешь, ест, едим, едите, едят. In possession statements, Russian uses у + gen. + есть (у меня есть хлеб, 'I have bread'). Homograph with есть ('there is').

сесть.natural: To sit down; to take a seat.
сесть.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. садиться), 'to sit down'. Use на + acc. for surface or в + acc. for vehicle/seat.

мясо.analysis: N. noun, 'meat'. Mass noun; used only in singular in standard usage.

красная.analysis: F. nom. sg. of красный, 'red'. Found in proper names like Красная площадь ('Red Square').

взвесьте.analysis: Imperative pl./formal of взвесить (perf., 'to weigh'). Standard polite request at a market or shop counter.

огурецов.analysis: Nonstandard form; correct gen. pl. of огурец (m. noun, 'cucumber') is огурцо́в, with fleeting е dropped.

огурецы.analysis: Nom. pl. of огурец (m. noun, 'cucumber'). The fleeting vowel е drops in plural and oblique cases: огурцы, огурцов.

килограмм.analysis: M. noun, 'kilogram'. Gen. pl. has two forms: official килограммов and colloquial килограмм (after numerals).

Помидоров.analysis: Gen. pl. of помидор (m. noun, 'tomato'). Used after numerals 5+ and quantity words: килограмм помидоров.

Помидор.analysis: M. noun, 'tomato'. Loanword from Italian pomodoro; native synonym is томат.

случиться.analysis: Perf. reflexive verb (impf. случаться), 'to happen, occur'. Often impersonal; the event is the grammatical subject.

память.analysis: F. noun (3rd declension), 'memory; remembrance'. Covers cognitive memory and commemoration (в память о + prep.).

приходиться.natural: To have to; to fall to one's share.
приходиться.analysis: Impf. reflexive verb (perf. прийтись), 'to have to'. Used impersonally with dat.: мне приходится ('I have to').

проходить.natural: To pass; to go through; to take place.
проходить.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. пройти), 'to pass, go through; take place'. Use мимо + gen. for 'past', через + acc. for 'through'.

свобода.analysis: F. noun, 'freedom, liberty'. Common phrase: на свободе ('at liberty, free').

составлять.natural: To составлять; to make up; to compose.
составлять.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. составить), 'to make up, constitute, compose'. Used for parts forming a whole or for amounting to a sum.

будто.analysis: Conjunction/particle, 'as if, as though'. Marks comparison or doubt; often expanded to как будто.

команда.analysis: F. noun, 'team, crew; command (order)'. Same word covers a group and an instruction (also a programming command).

поднять.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. поднимать), 'to raise, lift'. Irregular past: поднял, подняла, подняли (stress on ending in fem.).

причем.analysis: Conjunction, 'and moreover, what is more'. Adds a supplementary or contrastive detail to the preceding clause.

союз.analysis: M. noun, 'union, alliance; grammatical conjunction'. Same word covers political unions and parts of speech.

установить.natural: To установить; to establish; to install.
установить.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. устанавливать), 'to establish, install, determine'. Used for setting up equipment, rules, or facts.

врач.analysis: M. noun, 'medical doctor'. Same form is used for women in formal contexts; доктор also exists as a title.

договор.analysis: M. noun, 'contract, agreement'. Plural договоры (standard) or договора́ (colloquial).

стараться.natural: To try; to make an effort.
стараться.analysis: Impf. reflexive verb (perf. постараться), 'to try, make an effort'. Followed by infinitive.

уметь.natural: To know how; to be able.
уметь.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. суметь), 'to know how to'. Followed by infinitive; expresses learned ability, not possibility (мочь).

встать.natural: To stand up; to get up.
встать.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. вставать), 'to stand up, get up'. Irregular: встану, встанешь in future.

дерево.analysis: N. noun, 'tree; wood (material)'. Irregular plural: деревья, деревьев.

интересный.analysis: Adjective, 'interesting, engaging'. Short form интересен/интересна common in predicate use.

всего.analysis: Particle/adverb, 'only, just; in total'. Homograph with gen. sg. of весь ('all'); meaning depends on context.

добрый.analysis: Adjective, 'kind, good-hearted'. Standard in greetings: Добрый день ('Good day').

факт.analysis: M. noun, 'fact'. Loanword; common in academic discourse and in the phrase на самом деле ('in fact').

хозяин.analysis: M. noun, 'owner, host, master'. Irregular plural: хозяева, хозяев; feminine form is хозяйка.

длинный.analysis: Adjective, 'long (in length or duration)'. Double н in long form; comparative: длиннее.

домой.analysis: Directional adverb, 'home, homeward'. Used with motion verbs; the static counterpart is дома ('at home').

однажды.analysis: Adverb, 'once, one day'. Refers to a single occurrence in past or future; common in narrative openings.

природа.analysis: F. noun, 'nature; the natural world; inherent character'. Both 'wilderness' and 'essence of a thing'.

прошлый.analysis: Adjective, 'past, previous, last'. Common in time expressions: на прошлой неделе ('last week').

страшный.analysis: Adjective, 'scary, frightful, terrible'. Derived from страх ('fear'); colloquially intensifies (страшно холодно, 'awfully cold').

общественный.analysis: Adjective, 'public, social, communal'. Derived from общество ('society'); contrasts with частный ('private').

позиция.analysis: F. noun, 'position' or 'stance'. Used both physically (military/sports) and figuratively for an opinion or attitude on an issue.
