проводить.natural: To conduct; to carry out; to see off.
проводить.analysis: Impf. verb (pf. провести). 'To conduct' (a meeting, experiment) or 'spend' (time); with a person object it means 'see off'.

телефон.analysis: M. noun, 'telephone'. Also colloquially for the phone number itself (Дай мне твой телефон).

угол.analysis: M. noun, 'corner' or 'angle'. Has a fleeting vowel: gen. sg. угла. Locative в углу 'in the corner' vs. в угле 'in coal'.

бросить.analysis: Pf. verb (impf. бросать). 'To throw' or 'abandon'; with infinitive it means 'to quit' (бросить курить = quit smoking).

двор.analysis: M. noun, 'courtyard' or 'yard'. Stress shifts to the ending in oblique cases (двора́, дворе́). Also 'royal court' historically.

наиболее.analysis: Adverb forming the analytic superlative of adjectives and adverbs (наиболее важный 'most important'). More formal than самый.

обычно.analysis: Adverb, 'usually'. Marks habitual or default action; pairs naturally with imperfective verbs.

скоро.analysis: Adverb, 'soon'. Refers to the near future; for manner ('quickly') быстро is more common in modern usage.

далеко.analysis: Adverb, 'far'. Also used as a predicative ('it is far'): До центра далеко.

объем.analysis: M. noun, 'volume' or 'scope'. Used for physical volume, file size, and the extent of work or text.

писатель.analysis: M. noun, 'writer'. Agent noun in -тель from писать; feminine counterpart писательница.

разве.analysis: Particle introducing a question that expresses surprise or doubt: Разве ты не знал? 'You really didn't know?'

род.analysis: M. noun. Senses: lineage/clan, kind/sort, biological genus, and grammatical gender. Locative в роду́ 'in the family line'.

берег.analysis: M. noun, 'shore' or 'bank'. Locative на берегу́ 'on the shore'; nom. pl. берега́.

вера.analysis: F. noun, 'faith' or 'belief'. Takes в + accusative for the object of belief (вера в Бога). Also a common female name.

солнце.analysis: N. noun, 'sun'. The 'л' is silent in pronunciation: [со́нце].

спектакль.analysis: M. noun, 'theatrical performance'. A false friend with English 'spectacle' — refers specifically to a staged show.

завод.analysis: M. noun, 'factory' or 'industrial plant'. Typically larger or heavy industry compared to фабрика (light manufacturing).

способ.analysis: M. noun, 'method' or 'way' of doing something. Typically followed by infinitive or genitive: способ решения.

фирма.analysis: F. noun, 'firm' or 'company'. A modern borrowing; компания is the more general term.

цвет.analysis: M. noun, 'color'. Nom. pl. цвета́ 'colors'; the homograph цветы́ means 'flowers' (from цветок).

трудно.analysis: Predicative/adverb, 'it is difficult'. Takes a dative subject: Мне трудно понять 'It's hard for me to understand'.

возможно.analysis: Predicative/parenthetical, 'possibly'. As a sentence adverb it softens claims; as a predicative it means 'it is possible' + infinitive.

детский.analysis: Adjective, 'children's'. Derived from дети; appears in fixed terms like детский сад 'kindergarten'.

журнал.analysis: M. noun, 'magazine' or 'journal'. From French; also means a register or log book (классный журнал = class register).

руководитель.analysis: M. noun, 'leader' or 'manager'. Agent noun in -тель from руководить ('to lead'); the formal term for someone in charge of an organization or project.

специалист.analysis: M. noun, 'specialist'. Field is expressed with по + dative: специалист по экономике.

точно.analysis: Adverb/particle, 'exactly' or 'for sure'. Also a colloquial confirmation, similar to English 'right' or 'that's it'.

единый.analysis: Adjective, 'single' or 'unified'. Stresses unity or uniformity; common in official names (Единый государственный экзамен).

низкий.analysis: Adjective, 'low'. Used for height, level, quality, or pitch of sound. Comparative ниже.

нравиться.analysis: Impf. verb (pf. понравиться). Inverted construction: the thing liked is the subject and the liker is in dative: Мне нравится музыка.

объяснить.analysis: Pf. verb (impf. объяснять). Construction: объяснить кому что — explain something (acc.) to someone (dat.).

определенный.analysis: Adjective, 'definite' or 'certain'. Originates as the past passive participle of определить; often used to hedge ('a certain amount').

оценка.analysis: F. noun, 'evaluation' or 'grade'. Used for school marks and for any appraisal or assessment.

снять.natural: To remove; to take off; to rent; to film.
снять.analysis: Pf. verb (impf. снимать). Broad semantic range: take off (clothes), rent (an apartment), withdraw (money), film/photograph.

море.analysis: N. noun, 'sea'. The phrase на море means 'at the sea/seaside'; nom. pl. моря́.

песня.analysis: F. noun, 'song'. Gen. pl. is irregular: пе́сен (with fleeting -е-).

позволить.natural: To allow; to permit; to let.
позволить.analysis: Pf. verb (impf. позволять). Construction: позволить кому + infinitive. Reflexive позволить себе means 'to afford'.

процент.analysis: M. noun, 'percent'. After numerals it follows standard rules: один процент, два процента, пять процентов.

регион.analysis: M. noun, 'region'. A modern borrowing; область is the native equivalent and also a formal administrative unit.

родитель.analysis: M. noun, 'parent'. Singular is rare in everyday speech; the plural родители ('parents') is far more common.

связать.natural: To tie; to connect; to bind.
связать.analysis: Pf. verb (impf. связывать). 'To tie/connect'; also 'to knit'. Construction связать что с чем — link X with Y.

странный.analysis: Adjective, 'strange'. Same root as страна ('country'), originally 'foreign, from another land'.

услышать.analysis: Pf. verb (impf. слышать). The prefix у- adds completion: 'to come to hear, to catch (a sound)'.

чужой.analysis: Adjective, 'someone else's' or 'foreign'. Substantivized as a noun it means 'a stranger, outsider'. Direct antonym pair with свой.

весьма.analysis: Adverb of degree, 'very' or 'highly'. Bookish in tone; in casual speech очень is preferred.

основание.analysis: N. noun, 'basis' or 'grounds'. Common in fixed phrases: на основании 'on the basis of', иметь основания 'to have grounds'.

половина.analysis: F. noun, 'half'. In time expressions, половина седьмого means 'half past six' (literally 'half of the seventh').

требование.analysis: N. noun, 'requirement' or 'demand'. Verbal noun from требовать; often used in the plural for sets of conditions.

чистый.analysis: Adjective, 'clean' or 'pure'. Also figurative: чистая правда 'the pure truth', чистый случай 'pure coincidence'.

входить.natural: To enter; to go in; to be included.
входить.analysis: Impf. verb (pf. войти). 'To enter (on foot)' with в + accusative; also 'to be part of': входить в состав 'to be included in'.

легко.analysis: Adverb/predicative, 'easily' or 'it is easy'. With dative: Мне легко это сделать 'It's easy for me to do this'.

поехать.natural: To go by vehicle (once); to set off.
поехать.analysis: Pf. verb (impf. ехать). The prefix по- marks inception: 'to set off by vehicle'. Use на/в + accusative for destination.

поздний.analysis: Adjective, 'late' (of an event or hour). The 'д' is silent: [по́зний]. Comparative позднее.

положить.analysis: Pf. verb (impf. класть). Used for placing an object horizontally; pairs with ставить (vertical placement).

роман.analysis: M. noun. Two senses: a novel (literary genre) and a romantic affair. Also a common male first name.

автомобиль.analysis: M. noun, 'car'. The formal term; машина is far more common in everyday speech.

анализ.analysis: M. noun, 'analysis'. Also used in medicine for a laboratory test: сдать анализы 'to get tests done'.

круг.analysis: M. noun, 'circle'. Both geometric and social ('a circle of friends'). Locative в кругу́ vs. в круге for different senses.

специальный.analysis: Adjective, 'special' (for a particular purpose). Less emphatic than особый; corresponds to English 'specialized'.

стихи.analysis: Plural of стих (m., 'verse line'). In the plural it conventionally means 'poems' or 'poetry' as a body of work.

бумага.analysis: F. noun, 'paper'. In the plural бумаги often means 'documents' or 'paperwork'.

вместо.analysis: Preposition governing the genitive: вместо меня 'instead of me', вместо работы 'instead of work'.

впервые.analysis: Adverb, 'for the first time'. Built from в + первый; modifies a verb to mark an inaugural event.

литература.analysis: F. noun, 'literature'. Also used for a body of references or reading on a topic (научная литература).

экономика.analysis: F. noun. Two senses: 'the economy' (of a country) and 'economics' (the academic discipline).

видно.analysis: Predicative, 'one can see' or 'it is visible'. As a parenthetical it means 'apparently, evidently'.

господин.analysis: M. noun. The standard polite address to a man (господин Иванов = Mr. Ivanov). Irregular plural: господа́.

касаться.analysis: Impf. verb (pf. коснуться). Governs the genitive: касаться темы 'to touch on the topic'. Fixed phrase что касается 'as for'.

надежда.analysis: F. noun, 'hope'. Takes на + accusative for the thing hoped for (надежда на успех). Also a common female name.

научный.analysis: Adjective, 'scientific'. Derived from наука; covers both natural and social sciences (научный сотрудник = research fellow).

оказываться.natural: To turn out; to end up; to be located.
оказываться.analysis: Impf. verb (pf. оказаться). 'To turn out (to be)' or 'find oneself somewhere'. With instrumental: оказаться правым.

показывать.analysis: Impf. verb (pf. показать). Construction: показывать что кому — show something (acc.) to someone (dat.).

поэт.analysis: M. noun, 'poet'. Pronounced [паэ́т]; the feminine equivalent is поэтесса or, increasingly, поэт for both.

сложный.analysis: Adjective, 'complex' or 'complicated'. Implies many components; трудный stresses effort, сложный stresses structure.

степень.analysis: F. noun, 'degree' or 'extent'. Common phrase в какой-то степени 'to some extent'. Also academic degree (учёная степень).

вариант.analysis: M. noun, 'option' or 'variant'. The standard word for choosing among alternatives (другой вариант 'another option').

вокруг.analysis: Preposition + genitive ('around something') or adverb ('all around'): вокруг дома 'around the house'.

граница.analysis: F. noun, 'border'. Fixed phrase за границей 'abroad' (locative), за границу 'going abroad' (accusative of direction).

действовать.analysis: Impf. verb. 'To act' (take action) or 'to be in effect' (of a law, device). No direct perfective pair.

дух.analysis: M. noun. Senses: spirit (religious/philosophical), mood (в хорошем духе), and breath in fixed phrases (перевести дух 'catch one's breath').

заявить.analysis: Pf. verb (impf. заявлять). Used for formal or public declarations; common in news reporting (президент заявил, что...).

модель.analysis: F. noun, 'model' — a scale model, a theoretical framework, or a fashion model. Ends in -ь but is feminine.

откуда.analysis: Interrogative adverb, 'from where'. Pairs with куда ('to where') and где ('at where'); also relative: место, откуда я приехал.

отметить.natural: To note; to mark; to celebrate.
отметить.analysis: Pf. verb (impf. отмечать). Senses: mark (a date), note/point out (a fact), or celebrate (отметить день рождения).

предмет.analysis: M. noun. Senses: a physical object, an academic subject (in school), or the topic of discussion (предмет разговора).

реальный.analysis: Adjective, 'real' or 'realistic'. Modern usage also extends to 'feasible' (реальный план) or colloquially as praise.

операция.analysis: F. noun, 'operation' — medical surgery, military action, banking transaction, or any procedural step.

пара.analysis: F. noun, 'pair' or 'couple'. Used for matched objects (пара ботинок) and people (счастливая пара). In student slang, a 90-minute class.

сон.analysis: M. noun. Fleeting -о-: gen. sg. сна. Covers both 'sleep' (state) and 'a dream' (image during sleep).

название.analysis: N. noun, 'title' or 'name' (of a thing, book, place). For people's names use имя; название is for non-personal labels.

немного.analysis: Adverb/quantifier, 'a little'. Governs the genitive when used with nouns: немного воды 'a little water'.

ум.analysis: M. noun, 'mind' or 'intellect'. Common idioms: сойти с ума 'go crazy', в уме 'in one's head' (mental arithmetic).

повод.analysis: M. noun, 'occasion' or 'pretext'. Distinct from причина ('underlying cause'): повод is the immediate trigger or excuse.

способный.analysis: Adjective, 'capable' or 'talented'. With к + dative for a domain (способный к языкам) or with infinitive for ability.

старик.analysis: M. noun, 'old man'. Also used colloquially among male friends as an affectionate address ('buddy, mate').

мало.analysis: Quantifier adverb, 'few/little'. Governs the genitive: мало времени, мало людей. Compare немного (a small but positive amount).

малый.analysis: Adjective, 'small'. More formal/bookish than маленький; appears in fixed terms like малый бизнес 'small business'.

миллион.analysis: M. noun used as a numeral, 'million'. Like a noun, it governs the genitive plural: миллион рублей.

старший.analysis: Adjective, 'older' or 'senior'. Used for siblings (старший брат) and ranks (старший лейтенант).

успех.analysis: M. noun, 'success'. Often used in the plural to mean 'progress/achievements' (успехи в учёбе 'progress in studies').

кабинет.analysis: M. noun, 'office' (a private workroom) or 'study'. Also a school classroom for a specific subject (кабинет физики).

личный.analysis: Adjective, 'personal'. Derived from лицо ('person/face'); contrasts with общественный 'public, communal'.

необходимо.analysis: Predicative, 'it is necessary'. Stronger than нужно; takes dative + infinitive: Нам необходимо решить это.

обычный.analysis: Adjective, 'usual' or 'ordinary'. Describes something unremarkable; contrasts with особый or специальный.

получиться.analysis: Pf. verb (impf. получаться). Often used impersonally with a dative subject: У меня получилось 'I managed (to do it)'.

практически.analysis: Adverb. Two senses: 'in practice' (vs. in theory) and 'almost' (a hedge meaning nearly all/none).

ребята.analysis: Plural noun. Suppletive plural of ребёнок in informal use; commonly used to address a mixed group ('guys, folks').

свободный.analysis: Adjective, 'free'. Senses: politically free, unoccupied (seat/person), or available (свободное время 'free time').

счастье.analysis: N. noun, 'happiness' or 'good fortune'. The phrase к счастью means 'fortunately'. Note the silent 'т': [щасьтье].

высший.analysis: Adjective, suppletive superlative of высокий. Used in fixed terms: высшее образование 'higher education', высший класс 'top class'.

прекрасный.analysis: Adjective, 'wonderful' or 'beautiful'. Stronger than красивый; often used figuratively (прекрасная идея 'a wonderful idea').

база.analysis: F. noun, 'base'. Used for military bases, sports training facilities, and in compounds: база данных 'database'.

выход.analysis: M. noun, 'exit' or 'way out'. Both literal (the door) and figurative (a solution: выход из положения).

кричать.analysis: Impf. verb (pf. крикнуть for a single shout). 2nd conjugation: кричу, кричишь. Shout at someone uses на + accusative.

остановиться.natural: To stop; to come to a halt.
остановиться.analysis: Pf. reflexive verb (impf. останавливаться). 'To stop (moving)'; also 'to stay/lodge somewhere' (остановиться в гостинице).

прежде.analysis: Adverb, 'earlier' or 'formerly'. Common compound: прежде всего 'first of all, above all'.

пространство.analysis: N. noun, 'space' — physical, geographical, or abstract (математическое пространство 'mathematical space').

удар.analysis: M. noun, 'blow' or 'strike'. Also figurative ('a blow' as misfortune) and medical: удар = stroke.

защита.analysis: F. noun, 'defense' or 'protection'. Used in sports, law (legal defense), and academia (защита диссертации = thesis defense).

знание.analysis: N. noun, 'knowledge'. The plural знания is often used for a body of knowledge or skill set in a field.

предлагать.analysis: Impf. verb (pf. предложить). Construction: предлагать кому что/+inf. — offer/suggest something to someone.

руководство.analysis: N. noun. Senses: leadership/management (the act), the leadership/management (the people in charge), and a how-to manual.

сюда.analysis: Adverb of direction, 'to here'. Pairs with здесь ('here, location') and отсюда ('from here').

текст.analysis: M. noun, 'text'. Used for written text generally, including lyrics of a song (текст песни).

темный.analysis: Adjective, 'dark' (in color or lighting). Also figurative: тёмное прошлое 'a shady past'.

вовсе.analysis: Particle, 'at all'. Almost always used with negation: вовсе не 'not at all', вовсе нет 'not in the slightest'.

возраст.analysis: M. noun, 'age' (years of life). The phrase в возрасте means 'at the age of' or, used absolutely, 'elderly'.

гражданский.analysis: Adjective derived from гражданин ('citizen'). Covers civil (vs. military), civic (rights), and civilian (clothing).

молчать.natural: To be silent; to keep quiet.
молчать.analysis: Impf. verb, 'to be silent' (a state, not the act of silencing). 2nd conjugation: молчу, молчишь.

площадь.analysis: F. noun ending in -ь. Senses: a city square (Красная площадь), surface area in geometry, or floor area of a room.

сознание.analysis: N. noun, 'consciousness'. Used medically (потерять сознание 'to lose consciousness') and philosophically.

бежать.analysis: Impf. verb (unidirectional; multidirectional pair: бегать). Mixed conjugation: бегу, бежишь, ... бегут.

желание.analysis: N. noun, 'desire' or 'wish'. Common phrase по желанию 'optionally, at one's wish'. Verbal noun from желать.

линия.analysis: F. noun, 'line' — geometric, a transport line (линия метро), a phone line, or a family line.

несмотря.analysis: Preposition, always followed by на + accusative: несмотря на трудности 'despite the difficulties'.

пункт.analysis: M. noun. Senses: an item in a list/document, a location/station (пункт назначения 'destination'), or a clause.

рано.analysis: Adverb/predicative, 'early' or 'it is early'. With dative + infinitive: Тебе рано вставать 'It's early for you to get up'.

сильно.analysis: Adverb, 'strongly' or 'a lot'. Intensifies verbs of degree: сильно болеть 'to be very ill', сильно любить 'to love deeply'.

согласиться.analysis: Pf. verb (impf. соглашаться). Construction: согласиться с кем 'agree with someone', согласиться на что 'consent to something'.

сообщить.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. сообщать), 'to inform/report'. Takes dative for the addressee and о + prep. for the topic.

столь.analysis: Bookish degree adverb, 'so/to such a degree'. Modifies adjectives or adverbs; often paired with что in result clauses.

участник.analysis: M. noun, 'participant/member'. Derived from участвовать; the f. form is участница.

участок.analysis: M. noun, 'section/plot/precinct'. Mobile vowel: drops -о- in oblique cases (участка, участку).

губа.analysis: F. noun, 'lip'. Usually used in the plural (губы) to refer to both lips; stress shifts to the stem in the plural (гу́бы).

доктор.analysis: M. noun, 'doctor/physician'; also an academic degree. Nom. pl. takes stressed -а́ (доктора́).

дома.analysis: Adverb, 'at home' (location). Distinguish from до́ма (gen. sg. of дом) by stress and context; for motion 'homeward' use домой.

известно.analysis: Predicative adverb, 'it is known'. Takes a dative experiencer: мне известно, что… ('I know that…').

кажется.analysis: 3sg present of казаться (impf., 'to seem'). Used impersonally as a parenthetical, 'it seems', with dative experiencer.

папа.analysis: M. noun (informal 'dad'), declined like a f. noun in -а. Adjectives and past-tense verbs still take m. agreement.

петь.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. спеть/пропеть), 'to sing'. Irregular present stem: пою, поёшь, поют.

волос.analysis: M. noun, 'a single hair'. Hair on the head is referred to with the plural волосы; the gen. pl. is irregular: воло́с.

выглядеть.analysis: Impf. verb, 'to look/appear'. Has no perf. pair; complement takes the instrumental: выглядеть уста́лым ('to look tired').

вызывать.natural: To call; to summon; to cause.
вызывать.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. вызвать), 'to call/summon' or 'to provoke/cause'. Takes the accusative for the person or reaction elicited.

дочь.analysis: F. noun (3rd decl.), 'daughter'. Oblique cases insert -ер-: до́чери, до́черью; pl. до́чери, дочере́й.

показаться.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. казаться), 'to seem/appear'. Often used impersonally with a dative experiencer: мне показалось, что…

председатель.analysis: M. noun, 'chairperson/chairman'. The role is governed by genitive: председатель комитета ('chair of the committee').

представление.analysis: N. noun with two senses: 'show/performance' and 'idea/notion'. The second sense often appears in иметь представление о + prep. ('to have an idea about').

принести.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. приносить), 'to bring (on foot)'. Past stem is irregular: принёс, принесла́.

среда.analysis: F. noun with two senses: 'environment/medium' and 'Wednesday'. The day-of-week sense uses в + acc.: в сре́ду ('on Wednesday').

художник.analysis: M. noun, 'artist/painter'. F. form is художница; covers visual artists broadly, not just painters.

никак.natural: In no way; not at all.
никак.analysis: Negative adverb, 'in no way/not at all'. Requires the verb to be negated as well: никак не могу ('I just can't').

соответствие.analysis: N. noun, 'correspondence/compliance'. Common in the phrase в соответствии с + instr. ('in accordance with').

боевой.analysis: Adjective, 'combat/fighting'. Stress is on the ending throughout (боево́й, боева́я); figuratively means 'spirited/feisty'.

ветер.analysis: M. noun, 'wind'. Mobile vowel: drops -е- in oblique cases (ве́тра, ве́тру).

внешний.analysis: Soft-stem adjective, 'external/outer'. Common in fixed phrases like внешняя политика ('foreign policy').

зрение.analysis: N. noun, 'sight/vision'. Common in the idiom точка зрения ('point of view').

огонь.analysis: M. noun, 'fire'. Mobile vowel: drops -о- in oblique cases (огня́, огню́); also means 'gunfire' in military contexts.

отдать.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. отдавать), 'to give back/hand over'. Conjugates like дать: отдам, отдашь, отдаст, отдадим.

парень.analysis: M. noun (colloquial), 'guy/young man'. Mobile vowel: drops -е- in oblique cases (парня, парню); pl. gen. is парне́й.

попросить.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. просить), 'to ask/request'. Object of the request goes in acc.; what is requested can be infinitive or о + prep.

служить.natural: To serve; to be in service.
служить.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. послужить), 'to serve' (in the military, a job, or as something). Predicate complement takes the instrumental.

состоять.analysis: Impf. verb (no perf. pair), 'to consist of' (из + gen.) or 'to be a member of' (в + prep.).

выступать.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. выступить), 'to perform/give a speech'. Often used with с + instr. (с докладом, 'with a report').

грудь.analysis: F. noun (3rd decl.), 'chest/breast'. Loc. takes stressed -и́: в груди́ ('in the chest').

нос.analysis: M. noun, 'nose'. Loc. is stressed: в носу́, на носу́; the latter means 'right around the corner' idiomatically.

понятие.analysis: N. noun, 'concept/notion'. Colloquially не имею понятия means 'I have no idea'.

ставить.natural: To put; to place; to set.
ставить.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. поставить), 'to put/place upright'. Contrast with класть ('to lay flat'); also 'to stage' a play.

строительство.analysis: N. noun, 'construction/building (the activity)'. Derived from строить; for the resulting object use здание or постройка.

ухо.analysis: N. noun, 'ear'. Irregular plural: nom. у́ши, gen. уше́й.

возникать.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. возникнуть), 'to arise/appear'. Used for problems, ideas, or situations rather than physical objects.

рабочий.analysis: Substantivized adjective: as a noun, m. 'worker (manual/factory)'; as an adjective, 'working/work-related' (рабочий день, 'workday').

страх.analysis: M. noun, 'fear'. Common in the phrase со страху ('out of fear', genitive after preposition).

услуга.analysis: F. noun, 'service/favor'. Plural услуги often refers to commercial services rendered.

безопасность.analysis: F. noun (3rd decl., -ость), 'safety/security'. Built from без- + опасность ('danger').

глубокий.analysis: Adjective, 'deep' (literally and figuratively). Comparative is suppletive: глу́бже.

надеяться.analysis: Impf. reflexive verb (perf. понадеяться), 'to hope'. Takes на + acc. for what is hoped for: надеяться на успех.

продукт.analysis: M. noun, 'product'. Plural продукты commonly means 'groceries/foodstuffs'.

радость.analysis: F. noun (3rd decl., -ость), 'joy'. Common in the phrase с радостью ('gladly', instrumental after preposition).

содержание.analysis: N. noun, 'content/contents'. Refers to the substance of a text, message, or activity rather than physical contents (which is содержимое).

бизнес.analysis: M. noun, 'business' (a borrowing). Refers to commercial enterprise; uncountable in the sense of business activity.

видимо.analysis: Parenthetical adverb, 'apparently/evidently'. Set off by commas; expresses inference rather than direct observation.

вспоминать.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. вспомнить), 'to recall/recollect'. Object goes in acc. or о + prep. for 'thinking about'.

долгий.analysis: Adjective, 'long (in duration)'. Used for time spans; for physical length use длинный.

комплекс.analysis: M. noun, 'complex' (a set or grouping; also a psychological complex). Despite the literal gloss, it does not mean 'complexion (skin)'.

подняться.analysis: Perf. reflexive verb (impf. подниматься), 'to rise/go up'. Past stem alternates: подня́лся, подняла́сь.

сад.analysis: M. noun, 'garden/orchard'. Loc. is stressed: в саду́ ('in the garden').

зато.analysis: Coordinating conjunction, 'but (on the other hand)'. Introduces a compensating positive after a negative statement.

курс.analysis: M. noun, 'course' (of study, direction, or currency exchange rate). Common in курс рубля ('ruble exchange rate').

лето.analysis: N. noun, 'summer'. The gen. pl. лет is suppletive for год and means 'years' in counting (пять лет, 'five years').

называться.analysis: Impf. reflexive verb (perf. назваться), 'to be called/named'. The name takes the instrumental: книга называется «Война и мир».

одновременно.analysis: Adverb, 'simultaneously/at the same time'. Built from один + время; often followed by с + instr. for 'together with'.

помогать.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. помочь), 'to help'. Takes a dative recipient: помогать другу ('to help a friend').

предложение.analysis: N. noun with two main senses: 'offer/proposal' and grammatical 'sentence'. From the verb предложить.

прямой.analysis: Adjective, 'straight/direct'. Used literally for lines and figuratively for honest, direct speech or live broadcasts (прямой эфир).

сотрудник.analysis: M. noun, 'employee/colleague/staff member'. F. form is сотрудница; built from со- ('co-') + труд ('work').

тихо.analysis: Adverb/predicative, 'quietly/softly'. Also used impersonally: в комнате тихо ('the room is quiet').

финансовый.analysis: Adjective, 'financial'. Common in fixed phrases like финансовый кризис ('financial crisis').

возникнуть.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. возникать), 'to arise/appear'. Past stem drops the -ну-: возни́к, возни́кла.

значить.analysis: Impf. verb (no perf. pair), 'to mean/signify'. The parenthetical значит ('so/therefore') is extremely common in speech.

открытый.analysis: Adjective (past passive participle of открыть), 'open'. Used both literally and figuratively (открытый человек, 'open/candid person').

рот.analysis: M. noun, 'mouth'. Mobile vowel drops in oblique cases: рта, рту; loc. во рту́ ('in the mouth') is stressed and takes во.

технология.analysis: F. noun, 'technology'. Refers to a specific technological process or method; the broader sense uses техника.

знакомый.analysis: Adjective ('familiar/acquainted') that also serves as a substantivized noun ('an acquaintance'). Takes с + instr. for 'familiar with'.

недавно.analysis: Adverb, 'recently/not long ago'. Built from не + давно; refers to a moment in the past rather than ongoing recent time.

реформа.analysis: F. noun, 'reform'. Often used in the plural реформы for a program of changes.

камень.analysis: M. noun, 'stone/rock'. Mobile vowel: drops -е- in oblique cases (камня, камню); irregular pl. ка́мни, gen. камне́й.

нынешний.analysis: Soft-stem adjective, 'current/present-day'. Slightly bookish; derived from the adverb ныне ('now').

отсутствие.analysis: N. noun, 'absence/lack'. Common in the phrase в отсутствие + gen. ('in the absence of').

собака.analysis: F. noun, 'dog' (regardless of the animal's sex). Also the colloquial name for the @ symbol in email addresses.

будущее.analysis: Substantivized n. adjective, 'the future'. Declines like an adjective: в бу́дущем ('in the future').

звать.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. позвать), 'to call/summon' or 'to name'. The construction меня зову́т + name expresses 'my name is…'.

контроль.analysis: M. noun (3rd decl.-like ending but masculine), 'control/oversight'. Takes над + instr. for 'control over'.

позвонить.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. звонить), 'to phone/ring'. Takes dative for the person called: позвонить другу.

продукция.analysis: F. noun, 'output/produce' (collective). Refers to manufactured goods as a whole; contrast with продукт for a single item.

рассказ.analysis: M. noun, 'story/short story'. As a literary term, refers specifically to a short story; from the verb рассказать.

река.analysis: F. noun, 'river'. Stress shifts: acc. sg. is ре́ку with stem stress; pl. ре́ки.

сумма.analysis: F. noun, 'sum/amount (of money)'. Note the double м spelling, retained from Latin summa.

техника.analysis: F. noun with broad senses: 'technology/equipment' (collective) and 'technique/skill'. Contrast with технология (a specific process).

хватать.analysis: Impf. verb with two senses: 'to grab/seize' (perf. схватить) and impersonal 'to suffice' (perf. хватить), as in мне хватает времени.

вновь.analysis: Bookish adverb, 'again/anew'. Slightly more formal than снова or опять.

выпить.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. пить), 'to drink (up)'. Often refers to drinking alcohol when used without an object.

здание.analysis: N. noun, 'building'. Refers to a large or significant structure; for a general 'building' under construction use постройка.

ибо.analysis: Bookish causal conjunction, 'for/because'. Archaic in tone; in modern speech потому что or так как are preferred.

исторический.analysis: Adjective, 'historical' (relating to history) and 'historic' (of great importance). Context distinguishes the two senses.

народный.analysis: Adjective from народ ('people/nation'), 'folk' or 'people's'. Common in titles like народный артист ('People's Artist').

сфера.analysis: F. noun, 'sphere/field/domain'. Used both geometrically and figuratively for an area of activity (сфера деятельности).

больший.analysis: Adjective (comparative of большой), 'greater/larger'. Used attributively before a noun; the predicative comparative is больше.

знаменитый.analysis: Adjective, 'famous/renowned'. Carries a positive connotation; for neutral 'known' use известный.

иначе.analysis: Adverb/conjunction, 'otherwise/differently'. As a conjunction it introduces a consequence: поспеши, иначе опоздаешь ('hurry, or you'll be late').

необходимость.analysis: F. noun (3rd decl., -ость), 'necessity/need'. Common in по необходимости ('out of necessity').

потерять.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. терять), 'to lose (something)'. Used for loss of objects, opportunities, or qualities; reflexive потеряться means 'to get lost'.

фонд.analysis: M. noun, 'fund/foundation'. Refers to a financial fund or a charitable foundation/organization.

иметься.analysis: Impf. reflexive verb, 'to be present/available'. Bookish equivalent of есть; often used in formal or written descriptions.

лист.analysis: M. noun with two senses: pl. ли́стья ('leaves of a plant') and pl. листы́ ('sheets of paper'). The pl. form distinguishes the meaning.

подготовка.analysis: F. noun, 'preparation/training'. Refers to the process of getting ready; takes к + dat. for what one is preparing for.

пустой.analysis: Adjective, 'empty'. Used literally for containers and figuratively for empty words or promises (пустые слова).

очередной.analysis: Adjective from очередь ('queue/turn'), 'next in turn/regular'. Often implies 'yet another' in a series.

полностью.analysis: Adverb, 'fully/completely'. Formed from полный with the -ью ending, like an instrumental noun fossilized as an adverb.

получаться.analysis: Impf. reflexive verb (perf. получиться), 'to turn out/work out'. Often used impersonally with dative: у меня получается ('I'm succeeding').

республика.analysis: F. noun, 'republic'. Used for both sovereign states and constituent republics within a federation.

учиться.analysis: Impf. reflexive verb (perf. научиться), 'to study/learn'. Subject of study takes the dative: учиться русскому языку.

хозяйство.analysis: N. noun with broad senses: 'household', 'farm', or 'economy' (народное хозяйство, 'national economy').

бюджет.analysis: M. noun, 'budget'. Refers to a financial plan; can also mean a state budget by metonymy.

возвращаться.analysis: Impf. reflexive verb (perf. вернуться or возвратиться), 'to return/go back'. Destination takes в/на + acc.; origin uses из/с + gen.

воля.analysis: F. noun with two senses: 'will/willpower' and 'freedom/liberty'. Common in сила воли ('willpower') and на воле ('at liberty').

расти.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. вырасти), 'to grow' (intransitive). Past stem is irregular: рос, росла́; -ст- alternates with -с-.

судебный.analysis: Adjective from суд ('court'), 'judicial/court-related'. Common in судебное решение ('court decision').

деревня.analysis: F. noun, 'village/countryside'. Gen. pl. is irregular: дереве́нь.

мужик.analysis: M. noun (colloquial), 'guy/bloke'; historically 'peasant'. Carries a casual, sometimes rough tone in modern speech.

обнаружить.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. обнаруживать), 'to detect/discover/reveal'. Reflexive обнаружиться means 'to come to light'.

постоянно.analysis: Adverb, 'constantly/permanently'. Built from постоянный; expresses both unceasing repetition and ongoing state.

снег.analysis: M. noun, 'snow'. Loc. stressed: в снегу́, на снегу́; pl. снега́ refers to expanses of snow.

золотой.analysis: Adjective, 'gold/golden'. Used both for the material and figuratively (золотое сердце, 'a heart of gold').

источник.analysis: M. noun, 'source' (of information, water, etc.) or 'a natural spring'. Common in academic and journalistic contexts.

многое.analysis: Substantivized n. adjective, 'much/many things'. Used as a noun for abstract 'a lot': многое зависит от ('much depends on').

немец.analysis: M. noun, 'a German (man)'. Mobile vowel: drops -е- in oblique cases (немца, немцу); f. form is немка.

немецкий.analysis: Adjective, 'German'. Used for the language (немецкий язык) and anything pertaining to Germany or Germans.

обстоятельство.analysis: N. noun, 'circumstance'. Often used in the plural обстоятельства for the broader situation or set of conditions.

передать.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. передавать), 'to pass/hand over/convey'. Conjugates like дать: передам, передашь, передаст.

почувствовать.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. чувствовать), 'to feel/sense' (a sensation or emotion). The first в is silent in pronunciation.

элемент.analysis: M. noun, 'element/component'. Used in chemistry, mathematics, and general 'part of a whole'.

едва.analysis: Adverb, 'barely/hardly'. Also functions as a conjunction meaning 'as soon as': едва он вошёл… ('as soon as he entered…').

желать.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. пожелать), 'to wish/desire'. Takes genitive for abstract things wished for: желать счастья ('to wish happiness').

звезда.analysis: F. noun, 'star' (celestial or famous person). Stress shifts in pl.: зве́зды; gen. pl. звёзд with ё.

некий.analysis: Indefinite adjective, 'a certain/some'. Bookish; introduces a person or thing not previously known to the listener.

нормальный.analysis: Adjective, 'normal/ordinary'. Colloquially used as a positive evaluation ('fine/okay'): всё нормально ('everything's fine').

ожидать.analysis: Impf. verb (no direct perf. pair), 'to expect/await'. Slightly more formal than ждать; takes genitive for abstract objects.

технический.analysis: Adjective, 'technical'. Pertains to engineering or technology; common in технические науки ('technical sciences').

выбор.analysis: M. noun, 'choice/selection'. Plural выборы means 'elections'; from the verb выбрать.

городской.analysis: Adjective, 'urban, city-'. Forms a relational pair with сельский ('rural').

итог.analysis: M. noun, 'result, sum, outcome'. Common in fixed phrases like в итоге ('in the end, as a result').

масса.analysis: F. noun, 'mass'. Used both for physical mass and informally for 'a lot of' (масса людей = 'masses of people').

соответствующий.analysis: Present active participle of соответствовать ('to correspond'); used as an adjective meaning 'appropriate, corresponding'. Governs the dative.

составить.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. составлять), 'to compile, draw up, make up'. Often used for drafting documents or totaling amounts.

карман.analysis: M. noun, 'pocket'. Locative usually в кармане; figurative use covers money/means.

нести.analysis: Impf. verb (unidirectional), 'to carry (on foot, in one direction)'. Multidirectional counterpart is носить.

определить.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. определять), 'to define, determine, identify'. Takes a direct object in the accusative.

практика.analysis: F. noun, 'practice'. Covers both hands-on experience and professional practice (e.g., медицинская практика).

проведение.analysis: N. verbal noun from провести, 'the carrying out, holding (of an event)'. Common in formal/bureaucratic registers.

сестра.analysis: F. noun, 'sister'. Stress shifts in the plural: сёстры, сестёр.

сто.analysis: Cardinal numeral, 'one hundred'. Declines (ста in oblique cases); governs the genitive plural in nom./acc.

шесть.analysis: Cardinal numeral, 'six'. Like other numerals 5–20, governs the genitive plural (шесть книг).

ясно.analysis: Adverb / impersonal predicative, 'clearly; (it is) clear'. Often used alone as 'got it, I see'.

быстрый.analysis: Adjective, 'fast, quick'. Adverbial form быстро is high-frequency.

кухня.analysis: F. noun, 'kitchen'. Also means 'cuisine' (русская кухня = 'Russian cuisine').

любимый.analysis: Adjective (from passive participle of любить), 'favorite, beloved'. Also used as a noun meaning 'sweetheart'.

обязательно.analysis: Adverb, 'necessarily, without fail'. Commonly used alone to mean 'definitely, for sure'.

определение.analysis: N. verbal noun from определить, 'definition; (grammar) attribute, modifier'.

пользоваться.analysis: Impf. reflexive verb (perf. воспользоваться), 'to use, make use of; to enjoy (a right, reputation)'. Governs the instrumental.

родной.analysis: Adjective, 'native, own, related by blood'. Родной язык = 'native language'; родные can also mean 'close relatives'.

слава.analysis: F. noun, 'glory, fame'. Stock phrase: слава Богу ('thank God').

функция.analysis: F. noun, 'function'. Used in mathematical, biological, and general senses.

комиссия.analysis: F. noun, 'commission, committee'. Refers to the body of people, not a fee.

обеспечение.analysis: N. verbal noun from обеспечить, 'provision, securing, support'. Also 'software' in программное обеспечение.

применение.analysis: N. verbal noun from применить, 'application, use'. Refers to applying or putting something into use, not a request form.

работник.analysis: M. noun, 'worker, employee'. F. counterpart is работница.

улыбнуться.analysis: Perf. reflexive verb (impf. улыбаться), 'to smile (once)'. The -ну- suffix marks a single, completed action.

холодный.analysis: Adjective, 'cold'. Short form холоден/холодна used predicatively; adverb холодно is impersonal ('it is cold').

выборы.analysis: M. plural-only noun, 'elections'. Sg. выбор means 'a choice'; the plural specifically denotes a vote/election.

конкретный.analysis: Adjective, 'specific, concrete'. In colloquial speech also means 'clear-cut' or 'serious'.

появляться.analysis: Impf. reflexive verb (perf. появиться), 'to appear, show up, emerge'.

предел.analysis: M. noun, 'limit, boundary'. Used both physically and mathematically; в пределах + gen. = 'within the bounds of'.

смеяться.analysis: Impf. reflexive verb (perf. засмеяться/посмеяться), 'to laugh'. Use над + instrumental for 'to laugh at'.

фамилия.analysis: F. noun, 'surname, last name'. False friend with English 'family'; for kin use семья.

вроде.analysis: Particle / preposition + gen., 'sort of, like, kind of'. Hedges a statement or compares something loosely.

левый.analysis: Adjective, 'left (side); left-wing'. Colloquially also 'shady, on the side' (левый заработок).

подходить.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. подойти), 'to approach; to suit, fit'. With к + dat. = 'to walk up to'; with dat. alone = 'to suit'.

родиться.analysis: Perf./impf. reflexive verb, 'to be born'. Russian uses an active reflexive where English needs a passive: я родился в Москве.

судить.analysis: Impf. verb, 'to judge, try (in court)'. Use о + prep. for 'to judge about' something.

счастливый.analysis: Adjective, 'happy, fortunate'. The т is silent: pronounced [щасливый].

теория.analysis: F. noun, 'theory'. Standard -ия declension (gen. sg. теории, dat./prep. теории).

уехать.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. уезжать), 'to leave (by vehicle), go away'. Prefix у- conveys departure.

ученый.analysis: Adjectival m. noun (from учёный, past pass. participle of учить), 'scholar, scientist'. Declines like an adjective.

гора.analysis: F. noun, 'mountain'. Stress shifts: nom. горá, acc. го́ру, nom. pl. го́ры.

добавить.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. добавлять), 'to add'. Takes accusative direct object; к + dat. for 'to'.

занять.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. занимать), 'to occupy, take up; to borrow'. Sense depends on object: занять место vs. занять денег.

зона.analysis: F. noun, 'zone, area'. Also slang for a prison camp.

зуб.analysis: M. noun, 'tooth'. Nom. pl. зубы; gen. pl. зубов (no fleeting vowel).

личность.analysis: F. noun (3rd declension, ends in -ость), 'personality, individual'. Удостоверение личности = 'ID document'.

отдел.analysis: M. noun, 'department, section, division' (of an organization or store).

отказаться.analysis: Perf. reflexive verb (impf. отказываться), 'to refuse, decline'. Governs от + gen. for what is refused.

разработка.analysis: F. verbal noun from разработать, 'development, design' (of a product, plan, deposit).

святой.analysis: Adjective, 'holy, sacred'; also used as a m. noun ('saint'). Declines like an adjective in both uses.

считаться.analysis: Impf. reflexive verb, 'to be considered (as); to reckon with'. Predicate complement takes the instrumental.

товар.analysis: M. noun, 'goods, commodity, merchandise'. Often used in the plural (товары).

точный.analysis: Adjective, 'precise, exact, accurate'. Adverb точно also serves as 'exactly, that's right'.

влияние.analysis: N. noun, 'influence'. Use the construction оказывать влияние на + acc. for 'to exert influence on'.

зависеть.analysis: Impf. verb (no perfective), 'to depend on'. Governs от + gen.: это зависит от тебя.

звонить.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. позвонить), 'to ring; to call (by phone)'. Person called takes the dative.

медленно.analysis: Adverb, 'slowly'. Derived from the adjective медленный; double н is preserved.

метр.analysis: M. noun, 'meter' (unit of length). After 2–4 takes gen. sg. метра; after 5+ gen. pl. метров.

начинаться.analysis: Impf. reflexive verb (perf. начаться), 'to begin' (intransitive: of an event, period). Subject is the thing that starts.

носить.analysis: Impf. multidirectional verb (unidirectional: нести), 'to carry (around); to wear (clothing)'.

построить.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. строить), 'to build, construct'. The prefix по- marks completion.

праздник.analysis: M. noun, 'holiday, celebration'. The д is silent: pronounced [празник].

удовольствие.analysis: N. noun, 'pleasure, enjoyment'. Common phrase: с удовольствием ('with pleasure, gladly').

частый.analysis: Adjective, 'frequent, dense'. Adverb часто = 'often', one of the highest-frequency adverbs.

читатель.analysis: M. noun, 'reader'. Agent suffix -тель from читать; f. counterpart читательница.

акт.analysis: M. noun, 'act' (a deed, a legal document, or a section of a play).

актер.analysis: M. noun (also spelled актёр), 'actor'. F. counterpart актриса.

встретить.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. встречать), 'to meet, encounter'. Takes a direct object in the accusative.

значительный.analysis: Adjective, 'significant, considerable'. Adverb значительно often means 'much, considerably' before comparatives.

ответственность.analysis: F. noun (3rd declension, -ость), 'responsibility'. Governs за + acc. for what one is responsible for.

принадлежать.analysis: Impf. verb (no perfective), 'to belong (to)'. Owner takes the dative; group membership uses к + dat.

произнести.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. произносить), 'to pronounce, utter, deliver (a speech)'.

слеза.analysis: F. noun, 'teardrop'. Stress shifts: sg. слеза́, but nom. pl. слёзы.

создавать.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. создать), 'to create, set up'. Stem alternation -дава-/-да- across the aspect pair.

учитель.analysis: M. noun, 'teacher' (school). Nom. pl. учителя (stressed ending); f. counterpart учительница.

боль.analysis: F. noun (3rd declension, -ь), 'pain'. Note the gender: despite the soft sign, it is feminine.

занимать.analysis: Impf. verb (perf. занять), 'to occupy (space, position); to borrow'. Meaning depends on object.

было.analysis: Past tense, n. sg. of быть ('to be'), 'was'. Used with neuter or impersonal subjects, including existential 'there was'.

корабль.analysis: M. noun (soft stem), 'ship'. Gen. sg. корабля; stress on the ending throughout the singular.

это дом у.analysis: Phrase entry combining demonstrative это, m. noun дом ('house'), and preposition у ('near, at'). Matching ignores case and punctuation.

с.analysis: Preposition. With + instrumental = 'together with'; with + genitive = 'from, off (a surface)'.

но.analysis: Coordinating conjunction, 'but'. Marks contrast between clauses; usually preceded by a comma.

к.analysis: Preposition + dative, 'to, toward; by (a time)'. Spelled ко before consonant clusters (ко мне).

же.analysis: Emphatic/contrastive particle. Adds insistence or 'after all'; placed right after the word it intensifies.

о.analysis: Preposition + prepositional case, 'about, concerning'. Spelled об before a vowel, обо before clusters.

ли.analysis: Interrogative/subordinating particle, 'whether, if'. Placed after the focused word in yes/no questions and indirect questions.

должный.analysis: Adjective, 'due, proper'. Short form должен/должна is far more common, meaning 'must, ought to'.

конечный.analysis: Adjective, 'final, finite, terminal'. Distinct from конечно ('of course'), which is an adverb/particle.

уж.analysis: Emphatic particle, 'really, indeed'. Colloquial short form of уже; intensifies the preceding word.

война.analysis: F. noun, 'war'. Stress shifts to the ending in oblique cases (войны́, войне́); nom. pl. во́йны.

Москва.analysis: F. proper noun, 'Moscow'. Declines like a regular -а noun; stress on the ending throughout.

далёкий.analysis: Adjective, 'far, distant'. Adverb далеко = 'far away'; comparative дальше.

таки.analysis: Colloquial particle, 'after all, nevertheless'. Often hyphenated to the preceding word (всё-таки, опять-таки).

бог.analysis: M. noun, 'god, God'. Г is pronounced as [x] in бог and several derived forms.

советский.analysis: Adjective, 'Soviet'. Derived from совет ('council'); not capitalized in Russian.

русский.analysis: Adjective and m. noun, 'Russian (ethnically/linguistically)'. Contrast with российский, which means 'pertaining to the Russian state'.

Россия.analysis: F. proper noun, 'Russia'. Standard -ия declension (в России for 'in Russia').

ж.analysis: Particle, shortened form of же. Adds emphasis or mild contrast in colloquial speech.

солдат.analysis: M. noun, 'soldier'. Has zero-ending gen. pl. (пять солдат), like other military rank nouns.

чтоб.analysis: Subordinating conjunction, 'so that, in order to'. Colloquial short form of чтобы; followed by past tense or infinitive.

послать.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. посылать), 'to send'. Irregular present-future stem: пошлю, пошлёшь.

равно.analysis: Adverb / short n. of равный, 'equally; equals'. Common in всё равно ('all the same, anyway') and in math (два плюс два равно четыре).

капитан.analysis: M. noun, 'captain' (military rank, ship's master, or team leader).

тяжёлый.analysis: Adjective, 'heavy; hard, difficult'. Used both physically and figuratively (тяжёлая работа = 'hard work').

генерал.analysis: M. noun, 'general' (military rank). Distinct from the adjective генеральный ('main, general').

ладно.analysis: Particle / adverb, 'OK, all right, fine'. Used to agree or to wrap up a discussion colloquially.

дядя.analysis: M. noun (despite -я ending), 'uncle'. Takes masculine agreement; also a friendly form of address for an older man.

армия.analysis: F. noun, 'army'. Standard -ия declension; в армии = 'in the army'.

кой.analysis: Archaic interrogative/relative pronoun, 'which, what'. Survives mainly in set phrases (на кой чёрт, кой-какой).

рота.analysis: F. noun, 'company' (military unit of about 100 soldiers). Not 'company' in the business sense.

военный.analysis: Adjective, 'military, war-'; also used as a m. noun for 'a serviceman'.

медленный.analysis: Adjective, 'slow'. Note the double н, preserved across all forms.

возле.analysis: Preposition + genitive, 'near, beside'. Indicates close physical proximity.

черта.analysis: F. noun, 'line; trait, feature'. Used both literally (a drawn line) and figuratively (character trait).

лёгкий.analysis: Adjective, 'light (in weight); easy'. The гк cluster is pronounced [хк].

столе.analysis: Prepositional sg. of стол (m. noun, 'table'). Used after на or в: на столе = 'on the table'.

командир.analysis: M. noun, 'commander, commanding officer'. Refers to military leadership at unit level.

партия.analysis: F. noun, 'party (political); batch, lot; game/match'. Not a social gathering—use вечеринка for that.

мимо.analysis: Preposition + genitive / adverb, 'past, by'. Common with verbs of motion: пройти мимо = 'to walk past'.

толстый.analysis: Adjective, 'thick; fat (of a person or animal)'. Direct but not as harsh as English 'fat'.

сквозь.analysis: Preposition + accusative, 'through' (a substance or barrier). Stronger 'penetrating' nuance than через.

профессор.analysis: M. noun, 'professor'. Nom. pl. профессора (stressed ending).

худой.analysis: Adjective, 'thin, skinny (of a person)'. An older meaning 'bad' survives in set phrases (худой мир лучше доброй ссоры).

больной.analysis: Adjective, 'sick, ill'; also used as a m. noun ('patient'). Declines like an adjective in both uses.

след.analysis: M. noun, 'track, footprint, trace'. Used both physically (footprints) and figuratively (traces left behind).

улыбаться.analysis: Impf. reflexive verb (perf. улыбнуться), 'to smile'. Person smiled at takes the dative.

всякое.analysis: N. sg. of всякий used as a noun, 'all sorts of things, anything'. Common in бывает всякое ('anything can happen').

колено.analysis: N. noun, 'knee'. Irregular plural колени (gen. pl. коленей).

коридор.analysis: M. noun, 'corridor, hallway'. Regular hard-stem declension.

хватить.analysis: Perf. verb (impf. хватать), 'to suffice, be enough'. Used impersonally with gen.: хватит времени = 'there's enough time'.

многие.analysis: Adjective/pronoun, plural only, 'many (people, things)'. Often stands alone as a noun meaning 'many people'.

вниз.analysis: Directional adverb, 'down, downward'. Pairs with внизу ('down below', static location).

хлеб.analysis: M. noun, 'bread'. Plural хлеба́ can mean 'grains/cereal crops' in the field.

убить.analysis: Perf. infinitive, 'to kill' (impf. убивать). Takes a direct object in the accusative.

крикнуть.analysis: Perf. infinitive, 'to shout once' (impf. кричать). The -нуть suffix marks a single, momentary action.

трубка.analysis: F. noun, 'tube; pipe; telephone receiver'. Diminutive of труба.

враг.analysis: M. noun, 'enemy'. Animate, so accusative sg. is врага́.

двое.analysis: Collective numeral, 'two'. Used with male/mixed-gender groups and pluralia tantum (двое суток).

ладонь.analysis: F. noun, 'palm (of the hand)'. Soft-sign ending; declines like дверь.

спокойно.analysis: Adverb, 'calmly'. Also serves as a predicative ('it is calm/quiet') and a reassuring command.

лейтенант.analysis: M. noun, 'lieutenant'. Animate; accusative sg. лейтенанта.

служба.analysis: F. noun, 'service'. Covers military duty, employment, and religious services.

сорок.analysis: Cardinal numeral, 'forty'. Irregular: oblique cases all use сорока́.

молодая.analysis: F. sg. nom. of молодой, 'young'. Used adjectivally or as a noun ('the young woman; bride').

тридцать.analysis: Cardinal numeral, 'thirty'. Declines like a soft-sign feminine noun (gen./prep. тридцати́).

российский.analysis: Adjective, 'Russian' in the state/civic sense (of the Russian Federation), as opposed to ethnic русский.

синий.analysis: Adjective, 'dark/deep blue'. Soft-stem; contrasts with голубой (light blue).

столько.analysis: Quantifier, 'so much/so many'. Governs the genitive (столько людей).

достать.analysis: Perf. infinitive, 'to obtain; to reach; to pull out' (impf. доставать). Colloquially 'to annoy'.

железный.analysis: Adjective, 'iron; made of iron'. Figuratively 'firm, unshakeable' (железная воля).

упасть.analysis: Perf. infinitive, 'to fall' (impf. падать). Past tense: упа́л, упа́ла.

остальной.analysis: Adjective, 'remaining; the rest of'. Often substantivized in the plural: остальные ('the others').

московский.analysis: Adjective, 'Moscow; of Moscow'. Formed from Москва with the relational suffix -ский.

бой.analysis: M. noun, 'battle; combat; fight'. Locative form в бою́ for being in the thick of it.

вон.analysis: Adverb/particle. Points out something visible ('there!'); as a command means 'get out!'.

достаточный.analysis: Adjective, 'sufficient; enough'. The adverb достаточно is far more frequent.

трава.analysis: F. noun, 'grass; herb'. Stress shifts: nom. sg. трава́, nom. pl. тра́вы.

дед.analysis: M. noun, 'grandfather; old man'. Animate; informal counterpart to дедушка.

простить.analysis: Perf. infinitive, 'to forgive' (impf. прощать). Takes acc. of person and acc. of offence: простить кого за что.

бить.analysis: Impf. infinitive, 'to beat; to strike' (perf. побить, ударить). Irregular present: бью, бьёшь.

чай.analysis: M. noun, 'tea'. Takes partitive gen. чаю in colloquial speech ('чашка чаю').

кивнуть.analysis: Perf. infinitive, 'to nod once' (impf. кивать). -нуть marks the single gesture.

исчезнуть.analysis: Perf. infinitive, 'to disappear; to vanish' (impf. исчезать).

тонкий.analysis: Adjective, 'thin; fine; subtle'. Used for slender objects and for nuance (тонкий вкус).

звук.analysis: M. noun, 'sound'. Linguistic term for a speech sound as well.

президент.analysis: M. noun, 'president'. Animate; capitalised only when referring to a specific head of state in formal text.

спасибо.analysis: Interjection, 'thank you'. Historically from 'спаси Бог' ('God save you'); add за + acc. to thank for something.

болезнь.analysis: F. noun, 'illness; disease'. Soft-sign feminine; gen. sg. боле́зни.

кожа.analysis: F. noun, 'skin; leather; hide'. Context distinguishes the body covering from the material.

слать.analysis: Impf. infinitive, 'to send' (perf. послать). Irregular present: шлю, шлёшь, шлют.

молча.analysis: Adverb (verbal adverb of молчать), 'silently; without speaking'.

верный.analysis: Adjective, 'faithful; loyal; correct'. With dative: верный другу ('loyal to a friend').

оружие.analysis: N. noun, 'weapon; arms'. Treated as a collective: usually singular even when referring to several arms.

запах.analysis: M. noun, 'smell; odour'. Neutral term; the source is given with the genitive (запах хлеба).

неожиданно.analysis: Adverb, 'unexpectedly; suddenly'. Slightly more formal than вдруг.

вчерашний.analysis: Adjective, 'yesterday's; from yesterday'. Soft-stem, declines like синий.

вздохнуть.analysis: Perf. infinitive, 'to sigh; to take a breath' (impf. вздыхать). The -нуть suffix marks a single breath.

садиться.analysis: Impf. infinitive, 'to sit down; to take a seat' (perf. сесть). Reflexive; describes the action of seating oneself.

выше.analysis: Comparative of высокий/высоко, 'higher; above'. Also 'aforementioned' in formal text (см. выше).

офицер.analysis: M. noun, 'officer' (military). Animate; accusative sg. офицера.

толпа.analysis: F. noun, 'crowd; throng'. Stress shifts in plural: толпа́ → то́лпы.

перестать.analysis: Perf. infinitive, 'to stop doing; to cease' (impf. переставать). Followed by impf. infinitive: перестал курить.

придтись.analysis: Perf. infinitive (modern spelling прийтись), 'to have to; to be necessary'. Impersonal: мне пришлось ('I had to').

неизвестный.analysis: Adjective, 'unknown; unfamiliar'. Often substantivized: неизвестный ('the unknown man').

кресло.analysis: N. noun, 'armchair'. Distinct from стул ('chair') by the presence of armrests.

баба.analysis: F. noun, 'woman' (colloquial, often coarse or rural). In folk speech can also mean 'wife' or 'old woman'.

секунда.analysis: F. noun, 'second' (unit of time). Gen. pl. секунд for counting (пять секунд).

пожаловать.analysis: Perf. infinitive, archaic 'to come; to grant'. Survives mainly in the greeting добро пожаловать ('welcome').

тихий.analysis: Adjective, 'quiet; soft; calm'. Тихий океан is the Pacific Ocean.

сапог.analysis: M. noun, 'boot'. Zero gen. pl.: пара сапо́г ('a pair of boots').

стекло.analysis: N. noun, 'glass' (the material; also a pane). For a drinking glass use стакан.

протянуть.analysis: Perf. infinitive, 'to extend; to hold out (e.g. a hand)' (impf. протягивать).

десяток.analysis: M. noun, 'a group of ten; a dozen'. Used to indicate approximate quantity (десятки людей, 'dozens of people').

цветок.analysis: M. noun, 'flower'. Fleeting -о-; plural is irregular: цветы́ (flowers as blossoms).

ах.analysis: Interjection expressing surprise, distress, or admiration ('ah!', 'oh!').

дождь.analysis: M. noun, 'rain'. Soft-sign masculine; 'it's raining' is идёт дождь.

впереди.analysis: Adverb/preposition, 'in front; ahead'. As a preposition takes the genitive (впереди дома).

лоб.analysis: M. noun, 'forehead'. Fleeting vowel -о-: gen. sg. лба, prep. на лбу.

улыбка.analysis: F. noun, 'smile'. Gen. pl. улы́бок with inserted -о-.

ворот.analysis: M. noun, 'collar' (of a shirt); also a winch. Homograph with ворота (gate, plurale tantum).

ящик.analysis: M. noun, 'box; drawer; crate'. Почтовый ящик is a mailbox; colloquial ящик also means 'TV set'.

этаж.analysis: M. noun, 'floor; storey' (of a building). End-stressed in oblique cases: этажа́, этаже́.

голубой.analysis: Adjective, 'light blue; sky blue'. Distinct from синий (deep blue); slang sense 'gay (of a man)'.

нечего.analysis: Negative pronoun, 'there is nothing (to)'. Used with infinitive and dative subject: мне нечего сказать.

революция.analysis: F. noun, 'revolution' (political or technological). Loanword keeping -ция → -tion.

сосед.analysis: M. noun, 'neighbour'. Irregular plural: сосе́ди, сосе́дей.

чей.analysis: Interrogative/relative possessive pronoun, 'whose'. Agrees with the possessed noun: чья книга, чьё письмо.

поверить.analysis: Perf. infinitive, 'to believe' (impf. верить). Takes dative of person: поверить ему.

взглянуть.analysis: Perf. infinitive, 'to glance; to take a look' (impf. взглядывать). Takes на + acc. for the object of the look.

слабый.analysis: Adjective, 'weak; faint'. Covers physical, emotional, and signal strength senses.

уверенный.analysis: Adjective (past pass. participle of уверить), 'confident; sure'. Takes в + prep.: уверен в себе.

дурак.analysis: M. noun, 'fool; idiot'. Animate; common insult. Also the name of a card game.

пришлый.analysis: Adjective, 'newly arrived; alien'. Often substantivized to mean 'outsider, newcomer'.

висеть.analysis: Impf. infinitive, 'to hang; to be suspended' (state verb). Contrast with вешать ('to hang something up').

серьёзный.analysis: Adjective, 'serious'. Used for people, tone, and the gravity of situations.

стул.analysis: M. noun, 'chair'. Irregular plural: сту́лья, сту́льев.

поезд.analysis: M. noun, 'train'. Nom. pl. поезда́ with stressed ending.

тень.analysis: F. noun, 'shadow; shade'. Soft-sign feminine; locative в тени́ ('in the shade').

лошадь.analysis: F. noun, 'horse'. Soft-sign feminine; instr. pl. is irregular: лошадьми́.

разговаривать.analysis: Impf. infinitive, 'to converse; to talk'. No perf. counterpart; takes с + instr. for the interlocutor.

связанный.analysis: Past pass. participle of связать, 'tied; connected; linked'. Takes с + instr.: связан с работой.

горячий.analysis: Adjective, 'hot (to the touch); ardent'. Used for objects and emotions; жаркий describes hot weather.

повернуться.analysis: Perf. infinitive (reflexive), 'to turn (oneself)' (impf. поворачиваться). Takes к + dat. for direction faced.

острый.analysis: Adjective, 'sharp; spicy; acute'. Used for blades, flavour, pain, and angles.

король.analysis: M. noun, 'king'. Animate, soft-sign masculine; accusative sg. короля́.

полковник.analysis: M. noun, 'colonel' (military rank). Animate; derives from полк ('regiment').

мелкий.analysis: Adjective, 'small; fine; petty; shallow'. Contrasts with крупный (large-scale) rather than большой (big).

бок.analysis: M. noun, 'side; flank' (of a body or object). Locative form: на боку́, в боку́.

мозг.analysis: M. noun, 'brain'. Locative в мозгу́; plural мозги́ is common in colloquial expressions ('using your head').

крыша.analysis: F. noun, 'roof'. Slang: 'protection; racket', and крыша поехала ('to lose one's mind').

обратно.analysis: Adverb, 'back; in the reverse direction'. Used with motion verbs: идти обратно ('to go back').

дама.analysis: F. noun, 'lady'. Polite or formal; also the queen in playing cards.

семь.analysis: Cardinal numeral, 'seven'. Declines like a soft-sign feminine noun (gen./dat./prep. семи́).

веселый.analysis: Adjective, 'cheerful; merry; fun' (m. sg. nom.). Standard spelling весёлый with ё.

прислать.analysis: Perf. infinitive, 'to send (here, to the addressee)' (impf. присылать). Emphasises arrival, unlike послать.

милый.analysis: Adjective, 'dear; sweet; kind'. Also used as a noun of endearment ('darling').

мол.analysis: Reportative particle, 'they say; supposedly'. Marks quoted or second-hand speech without a verb of saying.

повторить.analysis: Perf. infinitive, 'to repeat' (impf. повторять). Takes a direct object in the accusative.

невозможно.analysis: Adverb/predicative, 'impossibly; it is impossible'. Followed by infinitive: невозможно понять.

зеркало.analysis: N. noun, 'mirror'. Plural зеркала́ with stress on the ending.

погибнуть.analysis: Perf. infinitive, 'to perish; to die (violently or in disaster)' (impf. погибать). Stronger than умереть.

американский.analysis: Adjective, 'American; of America'. Capitalised only at the start of a sentence in Russian.

дым.analysis: M. noun, 'smoke'. Locative в дыму́ ('in the smoke').

гореть.analysis: Impf. infinitive, 'to burn; to be on fire' (intransitive). Perf. сгореть. Transitive 'to burn (something)' is жечь.

плакать.analysis: Impf. infinitive, 'to cry; to weep' (perf. заплакать). Present: плачу, плачешь.

двигаться.analysis: Impf. infinitive (reflexive), 'to move; to be in motion' (perf. двинуться). Intransitive.

удивиться.analysis: Perf. infinitive (reflexive), 'to be surprised' (impf. удивляться). Takes dative for the cause: удивиться новости.

бабушка.analysis: F. noun, 'grandmother; old woman'. Diminutive of баба; affectionate.

вино.analysis: N. noun, 'wine'. Stress shifts in plural: ви́на ('wines').

осторожно.analysis: Adverb, 'carefully; cautiously'. Also a standalone warning, equivalent to 'Careful!'.

правильно.analysis: Adverb/predicative, 'correctly; right'. As a one-word response means 'that's right'.

держаться.analysis: Impf. infinitive (reflexive), 'to hold on; to keep oneself (in a state)'. Takes за + acc. ('hold on to').

лететь.analysis: Impf. infinitive (unidirectional), 'to fly' (in one direction). Multidirectional counterpart: летать.

лагерь.analysis: M. noun, 'camp' (military, summer, prison). Soft-sign masculine; nom. pl. лагеря́.

птица.analysis: F. noun, 'bird'. Animate; also collective sense 'poultry'.

ночной.analysis: Adjective, 'nocturnal; of the night'. Relational adjective from ночь.

зима.analysis: F. noun, 'winter'. Instrumental зимо́й serves as the adverb 'in winter'.

сухой.analysis: Adjective, 'dry'. Used for wine, weather, tone of speech, and texture.

километр.analysis: M. noun, 'kilometre'. Gen. pl. километров after numerals ending in 5-20.

кровать.analysis: F. noun, 'bed'. Soft-sign feminine; gen. sg. крова́ти.

привыкнуть.analysis: Perf. infinitive, 'to get used to' (impf. привыкать). Takes к + dat.: привыкнуть к шуму.

прочее.analysis: Substantivized n. adjective, 'other (things); the rest'. Common in the set phrase и прочее ('et cetera').

лестница.analysis: F. noun, 'staircase; ladder'. The т is silent: pronounced [ле́сница].

неужели.analysis: Interrogative particle, 'really?; is it possible that?'. Expresses disbelief or astonishment at the start of a question.

вверх.analysis: Adverb of direction, 'upward'. Used with motion verbs; the static counterpart 'up above' is наверху.

детство.analysis: N. noun, 'childhood'. Common collocation: в детстве ('in childhood').

остров.analysis: M. noun, 'island'. Nom. pl. острова́ with stressed ending; на острове ('on the island').

мешать.analysis: Impf. infinitive, 'to hinder; to disturb' (perf. помешать). Takes dative of the person hindered: мешать мне.

водка.analysis: F. noun, 'vodka'. Diminutive in form (from вода 'water'); gen. sg. водки.

темнота.analysis: F. noun, 'darkness'. Common locative: в темноте́ ('in the dark').

станция.analysis: F. noun, 'station' (train, metro, radio, etc.). Stress fixed on first syllable across the paradigm.

попробовать.analysis: Perf. verb, 'to try / give a try / taste' (impf. пробовать). Takes the infinitive or accusative.

странно.analysis: Adverb and impersonal predicative, 'strangely / it's strange'. Often used with dative: мне странно.

вскоре.analysis: Adverb, 'soon / shortly after'. More bookish than скоро and usually refers to past or narrative time.

заболевание.analysis: N. noun, 'disease / illness'. Clinical register; болезнь is the everyday word.

живот.analysis: M. noun, 'stomach / belly'. Stress shifts to the ending in oblique cases (живота́, животу́).

ради.analysis: Preposition + genitive, 'for the sake of / for'. Common in fixed phrases like ради Бога.

тишина.analysis: F. noun, 'silence / quiet'. Stress on the ending (тишина́, тишины́).

понятно.analysis: Predicative adverb, 'clear / understood / I see'. Common one-word reply acknowledging information.

фронт.analysis: M. noun, 'front' (military line; also weather or political front). Takes на + prep. (на фронте).

щека.analysis: F. noun, 'cheek'. Stress shifts: щека́ sg., щёки pl., with мягкий ё in the plural stem.

страшно.analysis: Adverb / impersonal predicative, 'scary / frightening / it's terrifying'. Takes dative: мне страшно.

наверно.analysis: Modal adverb, 'probably / I guess'. Colloquial variant of наверное; expresses likelihood.

выражение.analysis: N. noun, 'expression' (facial expression, set phrase, or mathematical/linguistic term).

слегка.analysis: Adverb, 'slightly / a bit'. Modifies verbs and adjectives to soften degree.

мешок.analysis: M. noun, 'sack / bag' (rough, like a sack of flour). Fleeting 'о' drops in oblique cases: мешка́.

обещать.analysis: Verb, 'to promise'. Bi-aspectual: serves as both imperfective and perfective.

собраться.analysis: Perf. reflexive verb, 'to gather / get together / be about to' (impf. собираться).

колоть.analysis: Impf. verb, 'to prick / stab / chop (wood) / inject'. Perf. counterparts vary by sense (уколоть, расколоть).

приказ.analysis: M. noun, 'order / command' (formal directive). Use приказать to give one.

закричать.analysis: Perf. verb, 'to start shouting / cry out' (impf. кричать). The за- prefix marks the onset of action.

кончиться.analysis: Perf. reflexive verb, 'to end / be over / run out' (impf. кончаться).

куст.analysis: M. noun, 'bush / shrub'. Stress shifts to the ending in oblique cases (куста́, кусту́).

стрелять.analysis: Impf. verb, 'to shoot / fire' (perf. выстрелить). Takes в + acc. for the target.

знак.analysis: M. noun, 'sign / mark / signal' (road sign, punctuation mark, zodiac sign).

кулак.analysis: M. noun, 'fist'. Stress shifts to the ending in oblique cases (кулака́, кулаку́).

стакан.analysis: M. noun, 'glass / tumbler' (for drinking). Чашка is the word for cup with a handle.

пахнуть.analysis: Impf. verb, 'to smell (of)' (intransitive). The smelled thing takes the instrumental: пахнет хлебом.

отсюда.analysis: Adverb, 'from here / hence'. Pairs with directional verbs like уйти, уехать.

лечение.analysis: N. noun, 'treatment / medical therapy'. Verbal noun from лечить.

сутки.analysis: Plurale tantum, 'a 24-hour day / day and night together'. Counted with collective numerals: двое суток.

вставать.analysis: Impf. verb, 'to get up / stand up / rise' (perf. встать). Present stem drops -ва-: встаю, встаёшь.

читаю.analysis: 1sg present of читать (impf., 'to read'). Regular first-conjugation -aть verb.

пишу.analysis: 1sg present of писать (impf., 'to write'). The с-→ш consonant mutation appears throughout the present tense.

лежит.analysis: 3sg present of лежать (impf., 'to lie / be lying down'). Used for inanimate objects resting on a surface.

сумке.analysis: Prepositional / dative sg. of сумка (f. noun, 'bag / handbag'). Used after в to mean 'in the bag'.

опаздывать.analysis: Impf. verb, 'to be late' (perf. опоздать). Takes на + acc. for the event missed.

приходит.analysis: 3sg present of приходить (impf., 'to arrive / come on foot'). Perf. counterpart прийти.

Кошка.analysis: F. noun, 'cat' (typically female or generic). Male cat is кот.

сидит.analysis: 3sg present of сидеть (impf., 'to sit / be seated'). State verb, not an action of sitting down.

окне.analysis: Prepositional sg. of окно (n. noun, 'window'). Used after в or на for 'in/at the window'.

учусь.analysis: 1sg present of учиться (impf., 'to study / be a student'). Reflexive; takes a place (в школе) or dative (русскому).

видишь.analysis: 2sg present of видеть (impf., 'to see'). Second-conjugation -еть verb with д→ж mutation only in 1sg (вижу).

внимательным.analysis: Instrumental sg. m./n. of внимательный (adj., 'attentive / careful'). Common after быть: будь внимательным.

важно.analysis: Adverb / impersonal predicative, 'importantly / it's important'. Takes dative + infinitive: мне важно знать.

пришёл.analysis: M. sg. past of прийти (perf., 'to arrive / come on foot'). F. пришла, n. пришло, pl. пришли.

другом.analysis: Instrumental sg. of друг (m. noun, 'friend'). Used after с to mean 'with a friend'.

работе.analysis: Prepositional / dative sg. of работа (f. noun, 'work / job'). After на means 'at work'.

делаешь.analysis: 2sg present of делать (impf., 'to do / make'). Regular first-conjugation verb.

читает.analysis: 3sg present of читать (impf., 'to read'). Regular first-conjugation -aть verb.

книгу.analysis: Accusative sg. of книга (f. noun, 'book'). Direct-object form; nominative ending -а becomes -у.

гуляем.analysis: 1pl present of гулять (impf., 'to take a walk / stroll'). Implies leisure, not just walking from A to B.

парку.analysis: Dative sg. of парк (m. noun, 'park'). After по means 'around / through the park'.

хотел.analysis: M. sg. past of хотеть (impf., 'to want'). F. хотела, n. хотело, pl. хотели.

пошёл.analysis: M. sg. past of пойти (perf., 'to set off on foot'). Colloquially used as 'let's go!' (пошли!).

ждут.analysis: 3pl present of ждать (impf., 'to wait / await'). Takes accusative for definite objects, genitive for abstract ones.

автобус.analysis: M. noun, 'bus'. Travel by bus uses на + prep. (на автобусе).

дому.analysis: Dative sg. of дом (m. noun, 'house / home'). After по means 'around the house'; к дому means 'toward home'.

готов.analysis: Short-form m. sg. adjective, 'ready / prepared'. Forms: готов, готова, готово, готовы.

вышел.analysis: M. sg. past of выйти (perf., 'to go out / exit on foot'). F. вышла, n. вышло, pl. вышли.

работаем.analysis: 1pl present of работать (impf., 'to work'). Regular first-conjugation verb.

спрятались.analysis: Pl. past of спрятаться (perf. reflexive, 'to hide oneself'). Impf. counterpart прятаться.

деревом.analysis: Instrumental sg. of дерево (n. noun, 'tree'). Used after за or под for 'behind/under a tree'.

идёте.analysis: 2pl present of идти (impf., 'to go on foot'). Used as 'you (pl./formal) are going / coming'.

мной.analysis: Instrumental sg. of я (1sg pronoun). Used after со to mean 'with me'.

делает.analysis: 3sg present of делать (impf., 'to do / make'). Regular first-conjugation verb.

Сделай.analysis: 2sg imperative of сделать (perf., 'to do / make'). Plural / formal form is сделайте.

пришло.analysis: N. sg. past of прийти (perf., 'to arrive / come'). Used with neuter subjects like время or письмо.

друга.analysis: Genitive / accusative sg. of друг (m. animate noun, 'friend'). Animacy makes accusative = genitive.

вижу.analysis: 1sg present of видеть (impf., 'to see'). Note the д→ж mutation, which appears only in this form.

говорим.analysis: 1pl present of говорить (impf., 'to speak / say / talk'). Second-conjugation -ить verb.

тебе.analysis: Dative / prepositional sg. of ты (2sg pronoun, informal). 'To you' or 'about you'.

времени.analysis: Genitive / dative / prepositional sg. of время (n. noun, 'time'). Heteroclitic stem in -ен-.

начал.analysis: M. sg. past of начать (perf., 'to begin / start'). Stress: на́чал m., начала́ f., на́чало n., на́чали pl.

бережёт.analysis: 3sg present of беречь (impf., 'to protect / take care of / save'). Note the г→ж mutation in conjugation.

берёт.analysis: 3sg present of брать (impf., 'to take'). Suppletive stem бер-; perf. counterpart взять. Distinct from the noun берет ('beret').

пальто.analysis: N. noun, 'overcoat'. Indeclinable: same form in every case and number.

выберешь.analysis: 2sg future of выбрать (perf., 'to choose / pick out'). Impf. counterpart выбирать.

придёшь.analysis: 2sg future of прийти (perf., 'to arrive / come on foot'). Conjugates like идти with prefix при-.

ушёл.analysis: M. sg. past of уйти (perf., 'to leave / go away on foot'). F. ушла, n. ушло, pl. ушли.

подарок.analysis: M. noun, 'gift / present'. Fleeting 'о' drops in oblique cases: подарка́, подарку́.

тебя.analysis: Genitive / accusative sg. of ты (2sg pronoun, informal). Used after prepositions like у, для, без.

ключ.analysis: M. noun, 'key' (for a lock; also musical clef, spring of water). Stress on the ending: ключа́, ключу́.

согласен.analysis: Short-form m. sg. adjective, 'in agreement / agree'. Forms: согласен, согласна, согласно, согласны.

русски.analysis: Adverbial form used in по-русски, 'in Russian / in the Russian way'. Always paired with the prefix по-.

был.analysis: M. sg. past of быть ('to be'). F. была́, n. было, pl. были; stress shifts in the feminine.

трудным.analysis: Instrumental sg. m./n. of трудный (adj., 'difficult / hard'). Common after быть in past/future tense.

дошли.analysis: Pl. past of дойти (perf., 'to reach a destination on foot'). Takes до + gen. for the endpoint.

моста.analysis: Genitive sg. of мост (m. noun, 'bridge'). Used after до, у, около to indicate position relative to a bridge.

останемся.analysis: 1pl future of остаться (perf. reflexive, 'to stay / remain'). Functions as 'we'll stay / let's stay'.

устала.analysis: F. sg. past of устать (perf., 'to get tired'). Used predicatively: я устала ('I'm tired', female speaker).

шагу.analysis: Dative sg. (also partitive gen. / loc.) of шаг (m. noun, 'step / pace'). Appears in ни шагу 'not a step'.

лучше.analysis: Comparative of хороший / хорошо, 'better'. Suppletive form; also used as a modal: 'better do X'.

спорю.analysis: 1sg present of спорить (impf., 'to argue / dispute'). Takes с + instr. for the person argued with.

него.analysis: Gen./acc. sg. of он/оно with prosthetic н-. The н- appears only after prepositions: у него, для него.

открыт.analysis: Short-form m. sg. past passive participle of открыть, 'open / opened'. Forms: открыт, открыта, открыто, открыты.

начнём.analysis: 1pl future of начать (perf., 'to begin / start'). Functions as 'we'll start / let's start'.

столом.analysis: Instrumental sg. of стол (m. noun, 'table'). Used after за to mean 'at the table'.

важное.analysis: N. sg. nom./acc. of важный (adj., 'important'). Often substantivized: 'something important'.

нас.analysis: Gen./acc./prep. pl. of мы (1pl pronoun). Used after prepositions like у, для, без, о.

всё.analysis: Nom./acc. n. sg. of весь, 'everything / all of it'. Also adverbial: 'still, all the time'. Contrast with все (pl., 'everyone').

сделаю.analysis: 1sg future of сделать (perf., 'to do / make'). The с- prefix marks perfective aspect of делать.

билета.analysis: Genitive sg. of билет (m. noun, 'ticket'). Used after без, у, два to indicate absence or possession.

темно.analysis: Impersonal predicative, 'it's dark'. Often paired with на улице or в комнате.

занят.analysis: Short-form m. sg. of занятый (adj., 'busy / occupied'). Forms: занят, занята́, занято, заняты.

идёт.analysis: 3sg present of идти (impf., 'to go on foot'). Also used for rain/snow (дождь идёт) and films/events.

дальше.analysis: Comparative of далёкий / далеко, 'further / farther / next'. Also 'go on / continue': что дальше?

дворе.analysis: Prepositional sg. of двор (m. noun, 'courtyard / yard'). Stress shifts to ending: во дворе́.

пусто.analysis: Impersonal predicative, 'it's empty / deserted'. Describes a space with no people or things.

мешает.analysis: 3sg present of мешать (impf., 'to disturb / get in the way of'). Takes dative for the person bothered.

обсудим.analysis: 1pl future of обсудить (perf., 'to discuss'). Functions as 'we'll discuss / let's discuss'.

устал.analysis: M. sg. past of устать (perf., 'to get tired'). Used predicatively: я устал ('I'm tired', male speaker).

свете.analysis: Prepositional sg. of свет (m. noun, 'light / world'). After при means 'by the light of'; after на 'in the world'.

лампы.analysis: Genitive sg. or nom./acc. pl. of лампа (f. noun, 'lamp / light bulb'). Context disambiguates.

легче.analysis: Comparative of лёгкий / легко, 'easier / lighter'. Note г→ч mutation in the comparative form.

болит.analysis: 3sg present of болеть (impf., 'to ache / hurt'). The aching body part is the grammatical subject: голова болит.

воды.analysis: Genitive sg. or nom./acc. pl. of вода (f. noun, 'water'). Common in partitive use: стакан воды.

пойду.analysis: 1sg future of пойти (perf., 'to set off on foot'). Marks the start of motion, not continuous walking.

двери.analysis: Gen./dat./prep. sg. or nom./acc. pl. of дверь (f. noun, 'door'). Soft-sign feminine.

холме.analysis: Prepositional sg. of холм (m. noun, 'hill'). Used after на to mean 'on the hill'.

урока.analysis: Genitive sg. of урок (m. noun, 'lesson / class'). Used after после, до, без to indicate timing.
